name: Shattersoul
description: Upon activation of this ability, you can remotely detonate any weapon that you have touched. You can even cause weapons you are currently handling to shatter when swung.
summary: The ability to cause any weapon you handle to remotely explode.
strengths: Powerful ability that usually serves as a trump card.
Can't be harmed by your own explosions.
Can be used on bullets.
weaknesses: The collateral damage will be massive for some weapons.
The ability to be protected from weapon explosions does not extend to others.

name: Single Solution Causality
description: This ability is good for those who believe in those miracle tools and cures. This ability changes causality and chance in order for anything to be the solution to any problem. Example, I use this ability on a hammer. "A bomb is going to blow" I throw the hammer and it somehow defuses it. "Alien Invasion" Throw my hammer at them and they all perish. That is what this ability does.
summary: The ability to warp causality in order to make a single object or method become the solution to any problem.
strengths: Make anything be the solution to any problem
Solve anything
weaknesses: None, but people could get bored if you use the same item or method.

name: Physical Understanding
description: This contact based power will allow the user to understand the physical capabilities of any machine. It will understand how it works, how to use in perfectly, and all internal pieces within the machine.
summary: The ability to understand the inner workings, and physical aspects on any machine.
strengths: Allows the user to understand the use of any machinery like guns or vehicles
Can reconstruct past objects that he or she has touched.
Can physically take apart and rebuild any object
weaknesses: No battle purpose other than creating weapons and using basic attacks

name: Infinite  Weapon Arsenal
description: this ability allows you to carry infinite amount weapons with you
summary: The ability to carry an infinite amount of weapons
strengths: you never run out of weapons
you're basically invincible in armed combat
the weapons are weightless when carried
weaknesses: so many weapons to choose from may be hard for someone

name: Function Mimicry
description: This ability can make someone the ideal carry-on tool. An example would be if the user mimicked the function of a hammer. Then they would be able to pound things like a hammer. You will have some of the strength and/or weakness of the tool that you mimicked. You won't actually turn into the object. You'll just be able to do what the object does. You can even absorb materials that one of the mimicked functions need like bullets if you had mimicked the function of a gun.
summary: The ability to mimic an object's primary function.
strengths: Can mimic any object that has a function.
No more need for object.
Have some of the strengths of the object.
weaknesses: Have some of the weakness of the object.
Only works on objects that have a function.
You need to understand the function and how it works.

name: Hacking
description: This power enables the user to easily hack into any computer network, password or hand-held device, to access   information the user needs. This works on electrically activated doors and stuff like that.
summary: The ability to hack anything
strengths: Can get any info from anywhere
Never forget your password
A job is ready set up at the F.B.I
weaknesses: Doesn't help fight anything
Limited when accessing networks by computer capacity

name: Ultimate Technopath
description: With this power, you are basically a god. Since our society is so dependent on machines, any piece of technology anywhere is within your power. You can control a nigh limitless army of technology that can continue to grow if you set up a few factories and program them to mass produce. The only problem with this power, you need absolute focus. If you're surrounded and battling six war fronts at once, your brain will shut down as if a computer from too much lag.
summary: The ability to control any technology anywhere in the galaxy
strengths: Godly in this time
Control all tech
Other technopaths can't touch this, you overpower them.
weaknesses: Focus, you need lots of it.

name: Tactile Efficiency
description: The overview says it all. The user is capable to make any object work better with him than anyone else through touch. A gun would be able to shot farther and able to hit a target. A computer can be used for hacking. Etc.
summary: The ability to make any object or tool work/perform better when you are touching it.
strengths: All objects/tools can be used better to almost supernatural levels.
weaknesses: Touch activates the power.

name: Weapon Summoning
description: This ability grants you the power to summon any weapon(even fictional) into your hands and use it against your opponent. Swords, guns, even light sabers will be at your command, and you will be unstoppable.
summary: The ability to summon any kind of weapon in existence.
strengths: Ready at every moment for a fight
Any weapon you choose
weaknesses: Drains life power, so you cannot use it repeatedly
Makes you tired after repeated use
Might summon the wrong weapon

name: Feather Weight Touch
description: A person with this power is able to make any object or item as light as a feather, regardless of how big or heavy it is. For example, someone with this power will be able to lift a car like it was only as light as a feather. If the item or object leaves the hand or hands of the user, the item or object will return to its normal weight. If the user were to use the item he or she is touching as a weapon, the enemy would feel the full weight of the object.
summary: The ability to make anything as light as a feather by touching it.
strengths: Can easily carry heavy items or objects. Do no need to hire moving men if you were to move houses
Can combat crime
Can be a good first responded in the event of a collapsed building,
weaknesses: None

name: Transmutation
description: You could take a pencil and change it into a high tech rocket. As long as you can clearly imagine it you can change something into it. And it does not have to be realistic, so it could be a futuristic weapon or robot. It could even be nonreal things like monsters. Refrigerators to time machine. Cat to mutant saber tooth tiger. Anything means anything!
summary: The ability to change ANYTHING into ANYTHING else one can clearly imagine
strengths: Becoming the best saleman ever...endless inventory from junk!
Could have anything you want!
You can create and destroy anything.
weaknesses: You must have something to change first.

name: Weapon Manipulation
description: One with this ability can psychically manipulate anything that is intended as a weapon (to hurt, harm or injure). Axes, knives, spears, harpoons, swords, guns, shanks, clubs, whips, bombs, etc. Are all under the user's power, and can be moved around and controlled as though by normal Telekinesis. This can be used to wield the weapon for yourself, or relieve others of their weapons, or even cause a gun to jam up and backfire on its holder. Any weapon is under your complete and total control.
summary: The ability to psychically manipulate anything that is intended to be a weapon
strengths: Makes aim and dodging a breeze (bullets, arrows and crossbow bolts are also considered weapons)
Take weapons away from your foes, and call your weapon to you if you lose it
Do that cool "Matrix" thing where you make the bullets stop in mid-air and drop to the ground
weaknesses: Will not work on any item unless it is intended to be a weapon at the time of its construction
Will not even work on a weapon if was made to be just a display or something
People with MythPower: Olympian Arsenal have weapons that are immune to this ability

name: Touch Of Knowledge
description: If you want to read a book but don't have the time, just simply touch the book and it will be as if you have read it. This also works on movies and if you touch someone you can pick and choose what you want to copy from them. Also, if you touch a computer and go on the internet, there is nothing you can't learn and it is untraceable.
summary: The ability to gain knowledge by touching it
strengths: Can learn anything
Doesn't steal knowledge from people
You absorb in a millisecond
weaknesses: Must touch the object
That's it

name: Fictional Copy Cat
description: Use the abilities and technological advances of any fictional character!  Become as powerful as Superman, or a strategist like Batman.  Use Iron Man's armor, or have Spider-Man's reflexes and spider powers.  You could even use Thor's hammer, or adapt and evolve like Goku and Vegeta!
summary: The ability to use the powers, talents, and gadgets of fictional characters.
strengths: Have Superman's powers!
Become smart and a martial arts guru like Batman
Have Darkseid's Omega Beams or Thanos' Infinity Gauntlet
weaknesses: You will have their weaknesses
May become too powerful
Too many abilities to remember

name: Digital Conversion
description: Also called Digitization, Digitalization, Data Conversion or Cybernetic Conversion, one with this ability can psionically convert matter and energy into digital data. This allows one to travel through cyberspace via a technopathic version of Astral Projection, as well as use electronic devices for storage, shelter and travel (via electronic wires and Wi-Fi signal connections). Not to mention, digital data may also be psionically converted into physical matter and energy equivalents, at will.
summary: The ability to convert matter to and from digital data
strengths: Convert self and others (including objects) into digital data, at will
Travel cyberspace via Technopathic Astral Projection (use electronics for storage/shelter/travel)
Convert digital data into physical matter/energy equivalents (bring cybernetic data to life)
weaknesses: Technopathy can affect digitized matter (to manipulate it, damage it or even delete it)
At the lower levels, the ability affects ONLY you, ONLY others or ONLY objects
If an electronic device is destroyed while digitized matter is inside of it, the data is trapped

name: Intuitive Inventing
description: Someone with this superpower can create almost any device imaginable. This is the uncanny and almost empathic ability to understand machines and to perceive "mechanical energy. " One can create fantastic futuristic devices, including cybernetic systems, holograms, and elaborate computer and fiber-optic systems.
summary: The ability to be able to invent anything they can imagine
strengths: Can replace limbs with robotic limbs
Can make a teleporting machine to travel
Able to make a machine to give or take powers away
weaknesses: Takes time to make
Cost a lot of money to buy supplies

name: Ultimate Programmer
description: AI for games, robots, satellites, research, space station facilities, etc. Anything you want to program you can, even to the point in which the AI has human creativity and intelligence as well as morals. Even graphics can look so realistic you can't distinguish them from real scenes or people.
summary: The ability to program any piece of electronics/tech one wants in any way one wants
strengths: Have a computer with which you can discuss philosophy.
People might pay loads of money for an AI you programmed.
weaknesses: May become a reclusive or taciturn nerd.

name: Codebreaker
description: This ability allows someone to break any code. With it one would be able to access any secret hidden from them, be they in a computer or elsewhere, by instinctively knowing how to break the "code" to get to it. The solution to the "code" could be anything from the correct computer password, to the exact things you need to say to get someone to tell you something.
summary: The ability to learn any secret.
strengths: You will be able to hack into virtually anything.
If you suspect someone is keeping something from you, it would be a simple matter to find out what.
The eventual ability to make codes and store secrets so that none could get at them.
weaknesses: It could be emotionally damaging to know what others really think of you.
This ability would eventually cause the user to see the world in numbers and symbols.
It only works if you know something is hidden away.

name: Digitalization
description: The ability to turn your entire body into a digital holographic form. Users may be able to hack into any computer based objects (computers, cell phones, satellites, exc. ), become intangible, cover their body in a digital armor and project weapons from their body. Limited to users imagination and energy. Users can draw energy from any electrical device they touch. Experienced users can also regenerate when touching an electrical device.
summary: The ability to digitalize yourself on a subatomic level.
strengths: Users are immune from deseases.
Extreamely difficult to harm.
Users can shape digital vehicales around body(tanks, jets, cars exc. )
weaknesses: Inexperienced users can get trapped in a single object(computer, cell phone, car exc. )
Users can be fatally wounded if infected with a virus
Users may have to reprogram theirselves if they get wet or catch a virus

name: Words To Items
description: A person with this power can turn their words into objects. They can get whatever they say out loud. For example if they say sword they can get a sword. If they are more specific they can get better items. For example if they wanted a gun but they wanted something that can shoot faster they can state Gun that shoots at lightspeed or is always faster than target. However the limitation of this power is that it cannot create people. The objects will disappear after a while.
summary: The ability to change words into items as long as the sentence begins with I want.
strengths: Get any weapon or device by saying it
Can get anything as long as it is not unique
It doesn't matter how fast you say it or what language you say it in
weaknesses: If people stop you from talking
Having an item doesn't mean you are proficient with it
No surprise because they will expect whatever you pull out

name: Digital Duplication
description: Your eyes scan any object whether they are physical or a mere representation. You are then able to duplicate the item perfectly from material around them.
summary: The ability to scan an object, then perfectly duplicate it in reality.
strengths: Near endless possibilities
Able to adapt to certain situations
weaknesses: Useless in pitch black situations
Material used must be of exact mass

name: Technologically Endowed
description: You will completely understand everything that is remotely technology. You will also have a sense of feelings for it, and it will all be under your control. When your human body dies, you'll still be alive in everything that's electronical, so you'll never die. In our world, where technology is becoming more and more like us, adaptive and a force to be reckoned with,... I give you this.
summary: The ability to completely control and be with one with technology
strengths: Control all technology and electrical machines and devices
Understand everything about it
Have knowledge of anything that is stored in a memory device or anything thats considered technology
weaknesses: Might lose respect for life
You know almost everything in the world, now what?

name: The Gambler
description:
With this ability you can win any bet no matter how ridiculous as long as you can get someone to agree to bet you. For example if you bet someone that you can lift 500lbs, you can. But if they do not agree on the bet you are out of luck. 
Note that bets should be carefully worded as techicalities still count and the outcome is not always what you hope for
summary: The ability to win any agreed upon bet
strengths: Never lose a bet
Can igrnore laws of physics to win bets
As long a some one agrees to bet you, you can do anything
weaknesses: You must have someone to accept the bet to suceed
Bets work to the letter, eg 'A bullet cannot kill me ' means that you could still be gravely injured
Winning the bet does not force the other party to pay up, they may try to stiff you

name: God Of Inventing
description: With this power you can make ALL kinds of objects and advanced in the invention, improvement to old technology. You can use advanced strategy on how would your invention can be used. You are the worlds greatest Inventor and scientist, engineer, strategist.
summary: The ability to be the world's greatest scientist, engineer, inventor, mathematician and a master strategist
strengths: You can make almost anything.
You can improve old technology.
You might get rich by selling your inventions.
weaknesses: People want to use for themselves.
You're not a real god, you're still just a man.
You can still be killed.

name: Unlimited Ammunition
description: Any cannon, bow, gun, slingshot, etc will have more ammunition replace the fired ammunition the instant the used ammunition is fired.
summary: The ability to have unlimited ammunition for any weapon one fires
strengths: You can just keep firing at will and never need to buy more ammunition.
Saving lots of money.
weaknesses: Your superiors might wonder why you never need to get more ammunition.

name: Lygokinesis
description: Lygokinesis is the power to produce an energy that is completely in your control. You can make it into anything you want from swords to robotic suits its up to the limits of your mind. The energy will appear similar to the type that the green lanturn makes but with two differences. One it is not hard light its your own energy. Two it dosen't have to be green it can be any color you want.
summary: The ability to produce and control raw energy
strengths: Very useful power
Can be any color you want
Can be anything you want
weaknesses: The energy dosen't have much detail

name: Technomancy
description: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. This ability lets you make devices advance to that point. Your power is easly confused with magic, but is immune to all powers that affect it. Conversly, your power is still affected by technopathic powers. You create a machine that can do virtually anything a mage, wizard, witch, sorcerer, sorceress, seer, or other magic user could do.
summary: The ability to change technology to make it so advanced that it gets confused with magic
strengths: Magic-ish powers.
Immune to magic affecting powers.
weaknesses: Technopaths will try to use your technology.
You have to have some device to advance.
Learning how to use the technologies and/or machines might be difficult.
tags: any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic

name: Mastermind
description: A person with this ability can choose one type of minion, such as ninjas, zombies, or robots, and summon them to follow his command. At first only a small amount of low ranking minions can be summoned but the more the power is used a larger number and higher ranked set of minions can be summoned. The mastermind can also cast upgrades onto weaker minions to make them more powerful as higher ranked minions are able to be summoned. The minions will follow the mastermind unquestioningly.
summary: The ability to summon minions and upgrade them.
strengths: Summon and train your favorite type of minion.
The minions will always follow your commands exactly as you want them too.
Can upgrade weaker minions so they do not become useless.
weaknesses: Once a type of minion is chosen it cannot be changed.
The higher ranked a minion is, the less can be summoned.
Available minions start out weak, and higher ranks must be trained.

name: Creator
description: When you make your world, you also make what's in it and control it. After you make your world and the things inside of it, you can use the objects as a weapon without harming it and also without killing it.
summary: The ability to destroy, create, and control your own world
strengths: It will protect the good
It helps with travel
It's very strong
weaknesses: Sometimes unstoppable
Goes in a different way sometimes
Loses strengh sometimes

name: Energy Weapon Generation
description: This ability allows for the hero or villain to create a weapon made of energy, with the right amount of focus. The weapons appears in the hand, glowing in the color of the users choosing. The weapon may only be weilded by the user and has twice the lethality of normal weaponry. An energy sword would cut through more than a normal sword but not everything. The weapons are created by syphoning off the user's energy. So too many, too big or too powerful of a weapon causes the user to pass out
summary: The ability to create any weapon made of pure energy.
strengths: Any weapon any time
Highly lethal weapons
weaknesses: Drains own energy
Requires focus so faster generation is harder

name: Technopathy
description: A person with Technopathy can control any form of computer-based device. They can mentally write computer programs, manipulate data streams, and use their abilities to infulence real-world events.
summary: The ability to communicate mentally with electronics
strengths: ATM machines are now the same thing as free money
Write e-mails with your mind
Make everyone's cell phone ring at once
weaknesses: Powerless without technology
Computer viruses
Firewalls

name: Mechassimilation
description: Bond with any metal or metallic object within 800 yards, pulling them to you from a distance. The metal parts will wrap around your body by themselves as they bond to you, attaching and arranging themselves according to your thoughts. You can also dismantle other machines for more parts, and not just metal itself. You can combine those machines to your body WITHOUT disassembling them, and become a Transformer! Physics still affects you however, so be careful how much metal you bond with!
summary: The ability to bond metal parts, or machines of any kind to your body in the form of armor or weapons
strengths: Bonding with machines is a better idea than just raw metal, as you can strengthen your body.
Metal bonded to your body becomes almost a second skin, and will not come off. Great for protection!
Iron Man made easy! Make yourself a battlesuit made entirely of android parts by mere thought!
weaknesses: Intense psychic control and focus is needed to draw in metal from a distance.
Metal broken, or severed from your body in any way cannot be salvaged, and must be replaced.
Dismantling a working machine renders it useless, and after that, can only be used for parts.

name: Energy Blasts
description: Energy Blasts power alows you to create energy, blast energy, and create weapons with energy. For example: if your dad's boat hit a rock, you can lift the boat off the rock, AND patch up the hole. Or say a giant robot is wrecking the city: you can trip it, pin it down, then slice it down with an energy sword. Some techniques take practice.
summary: The ability to shoot energy from every part of your body
strengths: You can make weapons.
You can make energy shields.
weaknesses: You still need to train.
You can't always control it

name: Deus Ex Machina
description: "God from the machine" is what it means. When you're trapped in an inescapable dangerous situation, you just yell out "Deus ex machina" & a person or thing will appear out of nowhere & help you out. In simple terms, its a "get out of jail free card"
summary: The ability to produce a "miracle" to get you out of an impossible situation
strengths: A reality bending power that gets you out of trouble
weaknesses: Must yell out "Deus ex machina" to work

name: Metallokinesis
description: You will mentally control all metal sources. You will be able to summon metal from the ground, shape and form metal into different constructs, like a suit of armor, shields or weapons. You can also repel metal projects from hitting you. You can even break and repair metal objects, or manipulate its properties (density, conductivity, color, etc.). This is not using Magnetism or Magnetokinesis.
summary: The ability to manipulate metal mentally
strengths: Control over metal
Can form it into armor and weapons
Can manipulate its properties
weaknesses: May be affected by magnetic power
May be affected by electric power

name: Computer Interface
description: You can control a computer to do anything you want, or transfer yours or someone else's conscious mind into any electrical device capable of containing it.
summary: The ability to control or transfer someone's conscious into computer.
strengths: See through any camera no matter the distance.
Trap enemies' minds in a storage device.
Put your own mind into a highly destructive robot.
weaknesses: Accidentally losing the mind you are transfering.

name: Data Beam
description: With this power you can create a beam of data that alters reality by changing the data of the objects it touches. Any type of data can be used to change objects, such as making things peaceful with peace data, setting things aflame with fire data, and changing to substance of something with a specific type of mineral data. The power can be trained to control range of beam and to control what the beam touches.
summary: The ability to create data beams that alter reality.
strengths: Can use any type of data.
Strong ability that can rewrite the code of anything.
Can change data to gain advantages in situations.
weaknesses: Removing the added data is difficult, without appropriate power.
Affects everything the beam touches.
Have to understand how the data will affect certain things.

name: Weapon Energizing
description: This ability is very versatile. You could be getting chased by some enemies, but you are defenseless. You find a twig on the ground, pick it up and it becomes an energy sword. Swords aren't the only weapons though, you may create guns, knives, bombs, etc. These weapons can be created from anything, from twigs, pencils, metal poles, anything.
summary: The ability to create energy weapons out of anything you touch.
strengths: Quick and easy.
Energized weapons are stronger.
Anything you have will make a deadly weapon.
weaknesses: May harm yourself if the item is not held correctly.
May cause falling debris if a weapon is created from a supporting pillar.

name: Positivity Construct
description: This ability allows one to create constructs withfrom their own positive attitude. The more positive, the better. When the user shows any sign of negative feelings, the constructs will fall apart.
summary: The ability to create constructs out of one's positive attitude.
strengths: Create constructs
More positivity equals more powerful constructs.
weaknesses: Negative attitudes will break apart your constructs.

name: Super Absorbency
description: If you touch any object you can absorb it's essence into your being.  You can do this with any object, whether it be a sword or a chocolate-unicorn-baby.
summary: The ability to absorb ANYTHING
strengths: You can use any weapon that you can absorb
weaknesses: There is a 50 - 50 chance that you will get injured by the object that you absorb

name: Iconoclast
description: Anyone or anything that has become fairly well-known to the public eye is capable of being damaged by you simply through touch, with the amount of damage ranging from complete disintegration to mild blunt trauma, depending on the fame of the item as a pop culture icon. This only applies to specific objects/people/images, in that, just because everyone knows what a gun is, does not give you any particular power over it.
summary: The ability to destroy popular culture icons through touch
strengths: Can destroy those annoying pop culture icons.
Beat up the popular kids at school easily.
Hold power over some of the most powerful people in the world; the bigger they are...
weaknesses: Doesn't work on generic objects, however well-known in concept.
If not careful, could touch and damage things you didn't mean to; no shaking the hand of your fav celebrity!
Can never become a famous person yourself.

name: Technological Omniscience
description: This ability grants the power to use any technology, from any dimensional plane / condition.
summary: The ability to use any technology via touch.
strengths: Use any technology, even beyond Earth Physics.
Can pass driving tests and wield weaponry like an expert.
weaknesses: Virtually a human weapon.
Unlike Technointegration, cannot be reversed.
Cannot use melee weapons, only mechanical-based.

name: Inherent Factual Omniscience
description: This power allows to give the correct answer(s) to any question where the answers are facts. Wether they asked it him/herself or someone else. It doesn't give knowledge about the future because that's not yet a fact.  That fact isn't automatically known to you unless someone asks the right question.  For example, someone can ask you how to make a device, and you'll know how. But you won't know a hitman is aiming at you when the question wasn't raised if you're being targeted.
summary: The ability to know the correct answer to any question about a fact
strengths: No more secrets
Asking the right questions will give you the knowledge about anything
If knowlegde is the key to power, then you have the key to ultimate power
weaknesses: If your power is found out you'll be a target for any organization or goverment
You won't know automatically if someone is about to kill you
You might be branded as a nerd. Even with an IQ below 60.

name: Data Collect
description: By looking at something, you are able to gain all the information regarding that object, person or element you've looked at. As long as it's a direct eye contact for 60 seconds
summary: The ability to collect data and use the knowledge to your advantage
strengths: You can use the information as intel for your bosses
You are able to find out the target's weaknesses
You can use the information to build something useful for you if it's a blueprint
weaknesses: If it is covered by something like a cloth, then the power is negated
You can't use this power without glasses.
You have to have direct eye contact for 60 seconds, no glances or one second sight

name: Target
description: Like Bullseye & Red Arrow, you'll have superb accuracy & marksmanship. Besides conventional weapons like guns, you'll also be able to use ordinary objects & turn it into a lethal projectile. Never mis your target & you can kill them with Post-It notes or staples.
summary: The ability to have perfect accuracy & marksmanship with almost any object.
strengths: Never miss your target.
Greatest assassin in the world.
Turn any object into a lethal weapon.
weaknesses: Have to be careful what you toss to a friend or you might kill them.
Become a Most Wanted because you are a super killer.

name: Mechanical Transmutation
description: This is the psychic ability to change one machine or piece of technology into another. One with this ability can change a computer into a TV, or a cellphone into a flashdrive. The user can even psychically advance a machine or piece of tech into its more advanced version (turning your old cellphone into a copy of the newest model, or any other type you desire, or the like). This ability can also reverse that process.
summary: The ability to change one type of machine or piece of technology into another.
strengths: Have any type of technology you want (Need a cell phone? Get a much cheaper version and change it)
Have it be as advanced as you like (If you don't like the new version, change it back.)
Change other people's tech as well (make it more/less advanced or just make it dysfunctional).
weaknesses: Often requires contact.
Must be of similar size (but this can be remedied by combining numerous pieces of tech).
If your power is undeveloped, you may not be able to control when tech changes, or what it becomes.

name: Fracture
description: With this power you can create a slice for up to a mile with a cut straight through, about 50 feet max. The cut that you produce will make a loud crack when you make it. To make your "slice of death," you need to clap your hands once together. The sound that you make is a crack as loud as a gunshot. You can also point with your index finger and make a sort of invisible micro light saber for up to a mile distance.
summary: The ability to use your telekinetic ability to make a straight, clean slice through any surface any length away.
strengths: With one clap, you can make a clean straight cut though anything, including foes or mountains.
With a point of your finger, you can draw a cut line for anything you need to do.
You can potentially end a fight with a great big applause. : )
weaknesses: You also cut anything in the way to your target.
There isn't a cool loud crack when you use the index finger method.
You can't see the split go on its way since it happens just like that right when the hands meet.

name: Adept Assassination
description: With this ability, you have the qualities of an adept assassin. You can easily murder any opponent, and when in need, you can cleverly use your surroundings to create weapons or traps. Before assassinating your victim, your stealth, agility and senses are greatly increased, and you have heightened knowledge of where to strike your opponent (his weak areas. ) However, these senses return to normal If you're not attempting an assassination.
summary: The ability to be an expert of assassination techniques.
strengths: Easily assassinate any average human, knowing all of his weaknesses.
You can devise clever tactics to defeat your opponents, such as traps or set-ups.
Usually manage to kill your victim without any problems, taking him out in one strike of your weapon
weaknesses: Your opponent, from prior knowledge, may still know you are attempting to assasinate him.
It may not instantly defeat others with Superpowers, depending on what power they have.
Does not give any effect whatsoever to you unless you are assasinating someone.

name: Weapons Eater
description: With this power you can gain a weapon's abilities by eating them. You will also not be hurt or adversely affected by devouring the weapon. When you eat a knife or sword you will be able to turn your arms into blades, if you eat a gun you will be able to shoot bullets from your mouth, if you eat shuriken you will be able to shoot shurikens from your hands etc.
summary: The ability to gain a weapon's abilities by eating them
strengths: You can gain a weapons abilities by eating them
You will never lose the powers you gain
You will not be adversely affected by eating the weapons
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Invisiwalls
description: With this power, you can create invisible walls of any size that prevent the passage of any and all matter. Be it for comedic purposes at the mall, for stopping that machine gun in its tracks, or for fulfilling your lifelong goal of becoming a mime, your invisible walls will never fail to deliver! They can be horizontal, vertical, diagonal, you name it, and you can create or remove them at will. You're limited to 25 walls at a time, only YOU can to see them, and they're planar (2D) only.
summary: The ability to create invisible, impassable walls of any size
strengths: Hours of entertainment creating walls for people to run into
Giving the goalies of your favorite teams a hand
Endless ways to defend yourself
weaknesses: Limit of 25 walls
2D only. That means no fancy curved walls.
If you build a house, privacy may be an issue

name: Weapon Immunity
description: A weapon is any object used by a living thing with intent to cause harm to another living thing. With this power, you are intangible to all weapons. This means you can't be harmed by anyone unless they use their bare hands, but you can't use weapons either. This includes walls and floors if someone throws or drops you into them. You are still vulnerable to accidents and superpowered attacks as long as there isn't a gadget behind it, and you can still harm yourself.
summary: The ability to be immune to all weapons
strengths: Basically turns every battle into a fistfight
Can pass through walls with some assistance
Seriously Frustrating
weaknesses: Still vulnerable to superpowered attacks and accidents
Attacks pass right through you and may harm your allies
Can only hurt people with your hands, better learn some pressure points

name: Paradigm Shift
description: You design an entirely new concept for science (or what you want it to ultimately achieve), and introduce it into reality. For example, if you want giant robots or superpowers, your power designs an energy or particle that will eventually result in that dream, within a decade. You can only do this once. After you have changed the world, you gain a power to control that concept or its results, like a specific technopathy for giant robots or power manipulation/bestowal powers.
summary: The ability to introduce a new concept into the world, and control it
strengths: The power to remake reality, and live like you're in fiction. It can be almost anything, even magic.
You then become a very powerful person in the new world. No one knows that this is unnatural.
You don't have to know how it would work, just the results you want.
weaknesses: You can only shift reality in this major way once. And it may take some time to develop.
You do not control what powers you might get in the aftermath.
You're limited to basically deciding what GENRE of fiction you want the world to be like.

name: Immortal Life Span
description: The person gets to live forever and never age.  However, there is a difference between  "Immortality" and "Immortal Life Span".  Your life span may be forever, but you are still able to be killed by fatal injury, gunshots, stabs, diseases and anything else that you can get killed by.
summary: The ability to live forever without aging a day.
strengths: You don't age once you reach to a good, healthy adult state.
There is NO time limit to your life span
weaknesses: You can still be killed by fatal injury, gunshot, diseases and anything else you can get killed by.

name: Space Manipulation Knowledge
description: You gain the knowledge to build any sort of device that manipulates space. This isn't limited to teleporters, it can include (but again, is not limited to) warp drives (and as a bonus, the rest of the stuff surrounding it), cloaking devices (by bending light through altered space), shrinking/growth devices (altering the relationship with space something has), superspeed devices, bullet/attack dodgers/distorters, and weapons that kill by changing the location of various parts of the victim.
summary: The ability to know how to build devices to manipulate space
strengths: Space manipulation is almost godly powerful if you know what you're doing
You can make any sort of variants or space-manipulating ideas you have. Want grenades? Storage?
You have one set of bonus, non-space related knowledge: all the other parts for spacecraft
weaknesses: While space is pretty powerful, there are definitely powers that balk it, and you have to build
You have to have modern day technology around to build most of the stuff
Nothing prevents the tech from being stolen, analyzed, disabled, etc.

name: Vorpal Sharpness Control
description: With a touch you can give vorpal qualities to anything, even non-edged surfaces. Sharp weapons cut better, while non edged weapons, objects, even your hands, can be imbued to cut through nearly anything. You can also imbue an item as a trap, such as making a doorknob cut anyone who tries to open it. You can also take sharpness away from things, turning knives and other edged weapons into awkward bludgeons against you.
summary: The ability to control sharpness in any object you touch, either imbuing or taking the quality of sharpness away.
strengths: Can make anything a lethal weapon
Can set traps for enemies
Cannot be cut by anything if you do not wish to be
weaknesses: Only lasts for an hour
May accidentally cut someone if careless

name: Techno Charisma
description: A person with this power has the ability to talk to and communicate with any machine and can command machines with their voice.
summary: The ability to talk to machines and control them via voice
strengths: Control machines with your voice
The power works on any type of machine or computer no matter how sophisticated
weaknesses: You also hear machines complaining about their jobs etc.
Only works on machines, cyborgs only have half the effect

name: Insta Weapon
description: With this power, you can instantly create a weapon out of midair. You have to know or have seen the weapon to create it.
summary: The ability to instantly create a weapon out of midair.
strengths: BAZOOKA TIME
LASER TIME
SHOTGUN TIME
weaknesses: You have to know or have seen the weapon to create it.

name: Stark Industries
description: With this power you can get products from Stark Industries. It is delivered to your location with free shipping. Stark Industries excels at robotics,green technology,etc.
summary: The ability to get products from Stark Industries.
strengths: It is delivered to you directly.
weaknesses: It loses to other industries.

name: You Create It You Control It
description: With this power you can control anything that you create. If you bring an object to life or somehow create some kind of creature with science or something they are automatically under your complete control. Even if you build a machine or robot you can control it even if you're far away from it. You can activate the machine and its functions and if it's a weapons you can fire it without even touching it.
summary: The ability to control anything that you create it
strengths: If you create a living being or bring something to life they are under your complete control
This works with resurrection as well
You can control machines that you build as well
weaknesses: If you never create anything this power is useless

name: Object Digitalization
description: The person with this power is able to digitalize an object, giving the appearance that it disappeared when in reality it is stored in a special digital holder. The user can also undigitalize the object that he or she has digitalized. Lower level users can only digitalize non-living objects where else higher level users can begin to digital 1 TB
summary: The ability to digitalize an object
strengths: Can easily digitalize enemies' weapons thus disarming them
Non lethal power
weaknesses: Only higher level users can digitalize living beings
Bad for fighting enemies with natural abilities if lower level user
Can never digitalize self (No Con Negation)

name: Human Transformer
description: When you touch people, you can enable them to turn into machines which suit their appearance and personality. So someone who's a construction worker might turn into a bulldozer, jackhammer, work truck etc. They can't control their transformation but since it is affected by the above factors, it may change over time. You can always undo the ability/transformation
summary: The ability to turn people into machines
strengths: Turn yourself and teammates into awesome transformers
Turn into a spy drone when feeling stealthy or a tank when angry
If your form has appendages, you can move them; like refrigerators can open etc.
weaknesses: Alternate forms dependents on appearance and personality
Takes about 10 seconds to transform so they might just shoot you while parts of you are still human
You may get angry and want to turn into a fighter jet but instead become a crossbow

name: Inanimate Object Potential
description: This means the user can "upgrade" any inanimate object. Not just technology, but anything inanimate. Example: instead of a back-breaking mattress on the floor, how about a king size super-comfortable bed with a dozen feather pillows and a soft, warm, plush blanket? And that's just a random example!
summary: The ability to make any inanimate object reach its full potential
strengths: Turn everything you own from cheap and crappy to "would-be" very, very expensive things
weaknesses: Being envied for your very, very expensive things

name: Technical Superpowers
description: The user can say the name of a superpower aloud, which will allow them to attain it, but the name of the superpower must be the technical/scientific term for the superpower or they won't get it. The limit of superpowers the user can attain depends on the user's willpower.
summary: The ability to attain a superpower if you state the technical term for it
strengths: Attain superpowers by stating technical/scientific terms for them
Some people are good with technical terms
weaknesses: The limit is the user's willpower
Some people aren't good with technical terms
Powers cannot be attained without technical/scientific terms for superpowers

name: Card Powers
description: With this power you can use the power of card suits. Clubs gives you increased luck. Spades allow you to turn your hand into melee weapons. Hearts makes people fall in love with you at first sight. Diamonds grant you an indestructible skeleton made of diamond. You can only channel one card power at a time.
summary: The ability to channel the powers of card suits.
strengths: Have incredible luck in a fight.
Your melee weapons or indestructible skeleton may come in handy.
Always get the girl.
weaknesses: Can only channel one power at a time.
Diamond skeleton may increase your weight, giving you incorrect readings from a scale.
When you activate the hearts power, fangirls/fanboys will crowd around you.

name: Tele Builder
description: You can look at something, pick it up using your mind, and turn it into something different that works and is reliable. To do this, you can close your eyes, or hum, or whatever it takes to make you concentrate. The new device you have created can be whatever colour you like. This ability is sometimes called telekinetics, but that is only the ability to move things with your mind, not build them. Good luck!
summary: The ability to build something fool-proof and reliable with just your mind
strengths: You can make a device in the space of five minutes
You can turn even a crumb into a complete suit of armour, for example
The devices work smoothly and without problems
weaknesses: The devices disappear after an hour
The devices may fall apart if not put together properly (it takes practice!!! )

name: Unlocking Fingersnap
description: By clicking your fingers, you unlock any door or lock that you are focusing on. If you focus to a greater degree, the handle will turn and the door or lid will open as well.  This power works on electronic locks and systems as well, allowing you to bypass locked car doors, etc. However, the doors must have a mechanical element to unlock.
summary: The ability to unlock doors and objects by snapping your fingers
strengths: No jail cell can hold you ever
Could become a master thief without any tools
You're a really useful guy to have around
weaknesses: Locks that use magnets are resistant to your power
Can't unlock pin-encrypted devices, like phones or computers
Not a tremendously impressive ability

name: Technointegration
description: Resistance is futile: best line ever. And a Technointegrator can pull it off. By touching a piece of technology (telephone, computer, chainsaw, nanites, etc.) they can merge their best qualities with the machine's best qualities, making a 'cyborg-esque' being. They can also use the abilities of the technology they used: making calls, computing quickly, having a deadly chainsaw for a hand, etc. They can only absorb 3 technologies at a time and are still vunerable to disease.
summary: The ability to merge your biology with a technological device
strengths: Can use the abilities of the technology
Can merge with any technology
Able to remove the technology at any time
weaknesses: 3 different technologies at a time
Still vunerable to disease
Only as strong as your technology

name: Submit Gain
description: With this ability, any and all normal/special/supernatural/superhuman powers, abilities, skills, talents, items, objects and weapons that you submit to the superpowerlist website, you instantly, perfectly, and permanently gain it at any point in time that you want. All of which without any problem, difficulty, or trouble of any kind, and also regardless of any powers, abilities, skills, talents, items, objects, or weapons that are added to the superpowerlist.
summary: The ability to instantly and permanently gain any powers you submit to the Superpowerlist website.
strengths: Instantly and permanently gain any powers you want no matter what they maybe.
Instantly and permanently gain any powers even if they don't get added to the superpowerlist.
The creator of Submit Gain automatically gains this power no matter what, because of its nature.
weaknesses: Does not work on powers submitted before Submit Gain was created.
The Get This Power button will never appear for anyone who has this power.

name: Bookend
description: By touching a book you may summon characters and plot important objects to assist you. If what you summoned is destroyed it returns to the book, but you are unable to summon it again. You must be touching the book to summon from it. Summoning last up to 24 hours and can be dismissed at any time. Pervious summons remember you. Anything or anyone summoned retains all traits that it had in the book so it would help to have read the book before summoning from it.
summary: The ability to summon characters and plot devices from books.
strengths: Access to powerful allies and weapons
weaknesses: Must convince character to assist you
Might summon something hostile
Must be touching the book to summon from it

name: Synthetics
description: With this, you can make synthetic things for various purposes without using any tools whatsoever. You can make artificial food by assembling together made-out-of-nothing proteins or generating meat from quickly created cells. You can change your DNA by inserting new proteins into it. You can extend or make permanent your youth and life. You can make primitive things as a whole, like a small piezoelectric stick as a weapon or contact lenses.
summary: The ability to create synthetic things for many purposes.
strengths: Can make materials out of nothing or isolate them.
Very versatile, such as genetic modification, artificial diamonds and spray on tan and pale parlor.
Can change appearances with organic or synthetic plastic surgery, also eternal youth.
weaknesses: Be creative or it will not be very effective.
People who like naturally-made things may hate you.

name: Superweapon Creation Knowledge
description: With things easily available to you in your hometown, this power allows you to build: thermonuclear weapons, suitcase thermonuclear weapons, "salted" thermonuclear weapons, neutron bombs, EMP weapons, chimera viruses, recreations of any natural pathogen, chemical weapons, super-tanks that hurl nuclear bombs like firecrackers, super-cannons, missiles which can be loaded with any of the above, and just about any sort of bomb or weapon of immense power you can imagine.
summary: The ability to know how to create WMDs and superweapons with common resources
strengths: If you're a super villain, or want to have your own nation.
Or, if you like your government, you could claim to be a scientist and sell the designs
You could probably figure out a heroic use for a thirty-foot tall Hunter-Killer robot
weaknesses: The sort of power that even if you're a hero, you'll want to hide
Not only can your stuff be stolen, but it can do A LOT of damage, and you're not protected from it
You'll either be terrified 24/7 of your stockpile going off, or terrified of a slip mid-manufacture

name: Emotion Based Weapons Creator
description: The weapons look different based on the emotions that are being used as a base but all the weapons have 3 things in common: a power core, restraints, and being extremely powerful. The power core provides power to the weapon (like electricity to a computer) and if broken the weapon is destroyed and rendered unusable. The restraint prevents the weapon from being at full power and going on a rampage in its true form. Each weapon is powerful enough to destroy a city.
summary: The ability to create weapons based on the feelings of oneself or others
strengths: The weapon could be anything from a spear to a laser gun.
The weapon chooses its wielder. May be a con.
weaknesses: You might not be able to use the weapon even though you made it.
Never ever let a restraint be destroyed or everyone around the weapon will be killed.

name: The Door
description: Just think of the door and it will come down anywhere and anytime. Through the door you will find weapons, cars, food, meds, and tech. Only you can enter though. Anything and everything is in there and you can sort it like in "The Matrix." The downfall is that you can't spawn other superpowers.
summary: The ability to spawn a door to a supply room wherever and whenever you want
strengths: Any weapon you want, including guns, ammo and melee wepons
Any car you want plus you can put guns on the cars too
You can hide in there if needed
weaknesses: Only you can enter
Can't get other superpowers

name: Magical Weapon Creation
description: This ability works by creating a weapon of your choice and adding a single magic type. For example, you can choose a sword and fire magic. You can choose even modern weapons such as a pistol or machine guns, or even futuristic weapons, but those will take a lot more concentration. Also, when you choose a weapon, you can only add one magic type to it. For example, if you chose a spear, you can't add both ice and lightning to it. You can, however, change the magic a weapon has.
summary: The ability to create magical weapons of any kind.
strengths: Can create any weapon and add any magic to it, healing, fire, ice, etc.
Can change the magic on a weapon, whether immediately or later.
Can activate magic powers upon will, and manipulate them to your will.
weaknesses: Magic works better with melee weapons and does not work as well with futuristic weapons.
You cannot add more than one magic per weapon.
You have to direct the magic through your weapon.

name: Weapon Draw
description: Just put your hand on the screen and think about the weapon. And you have the weapon you want.

strengths: Any weapon you want in your hand
You can have a car if you have a car game
weaknesses: The computer might be too far to touch it

name: Temporal Communication
description: A person with this power can talk with the past or the future by connecting with and electronic device. They will send the electronic waves backward or forward in time to call people. For example, you can call your future self to ask for the answers to homework or where a bomb is or how they defeated someone. You can also call the past and risk creating a temporal paradox. However if a paradox is created the user of this power is unaffected by the paradox and retains their memory and their body.
summary: The ability to communicate with the past or the future through electronics(email, phone, text, etc. )
strengths: Calling the future is similar to prerecognition
Calling the past to fix temporal paradoxes or create them
Even if a paradox is created you will not be affected and retain all memories
weaknesses: You need to have a communication device
If phones don't work in the future
You don't know what phone number to call in the past or future

name: Digital Power Acquisition
description: By implanting a wireless neural implant in the brain, the user can 'program' their body (with a computer) to acquire superpowers. Based on this code, the implant constructs synthetic viruses to take the modified genes to the body, thereby imbuing the power. Any mistakes in the code could be fatal, but the implant can also convert from power to code, thus creating a central database of working abilities. The imbuing process is long and painful, though, 11+ hours and a lot of pain. Is it worth it?
summary: The ability to digitally acquire superpowers via a neural implant.
strengths: No limit to the amount of powers you can obtain.
The type of power limited only by your programming knowledge.
If a partner has this you can share abilities.
weaknesses: Imbuing process is long and painful.
Quite easy to make mistakes in the coding, so must be heavily debugged.
Technopaths. This power can be Self-Negated to defend against this though.

name: Stasis Field Projection
description: A person with this power can be the best neutralizer. While this power can be used offensively to create swords and other weapons, the main function is to trap and capture targets. You can use the field as a forcefield or you can wrap it around a target to freeze them in time. When frozen, they will not age and you can maneuver the bubble of frozen time. The stasis field also acts similar to an EMP which prevents nearby electronics from functioning. People in stasis can be revived later.

strengths: Stasis fields have near infinite durability and you can use it as a weapon
Can neutralize anything surrounded by stasis field-they are frozen in time
Can act as an EMP
weaknesses: If you put yourself in full stasis, it will be very hard to get you back
The stasis field requires concentration from the user
You cannot attack people in stasis fields, they are protected by your barrier

name: Super Cryptography
description: This power allows you to decode any code, mostly by patterns you do not even need the cypher to decode it. Also, you can find patterns in anything whether it is by looking at someone's past actions or numbers or anything. This power is useful to a detective or private investigator or anyone needing to decode anything. This power also makes you bilingual in a way, considering you do not need to understand the language of the code to understand it. You can also create amazing codes.
summary: The ability to decode any code and find any pattern
strengths: You can decode any code even if it is in a language you do not understand and create the best codes
You can find patterns in anything
You would be an amazing detective and amazing at predicting people's actions
weaknesses: You can see patterns where they do not exist
If you do not wanna be an investigator/ cryptographer, this power is kinda useless
People will get annoyed when you call them predictable

name: Power Filter
description: This power allows you to obtain a temporary copy of any power you encounter, simply by touching the person who has it. You can only hold one power at a time, and the power only lasts 24 hours. The best part of this power is that if you currently hold a copied power and you wish to keep it, you can permanently place it into an object, such as a weapon or clothing. So long as you have the object, you have the power. The more powerful the power, the bigger the object needs to be.
summary: The ability to absorb and use any ability you encounter, and then place it in an object.

Keep the ones you want by putting them into objects.
Objects work with only the people you want them to work with.
weaknesses: Can't hold more then one power at a time.
Carrying around lots of objects can get tiresome.
You don't really have a power of your own.

name: Machine Body
description: With this power you can make any part of your body into a machine at will. Flesh becomes metal, veins become wires, bones become cables and any number of combinations, then back to normal. Like this, you can interact and manipulate electronics directly. It can be used to turn even a simple cell phone into a super computer.

Direct interface with electronics.
No security system can stop you.
weaknesses: VERY freaky to watch.

Does not make you invulnerable.

name: Digital Manipulation
description: This is nothing like Technopathy. Technopathy controls machines, Digital Manipulation controls the data. You can extract data from computers and place it in the real world. You can even create vortexes to the cyber world, transform real-world objects to data, access the Internet and software without computers, transform into data, control computer viruses, viral immunity, and even shoot and create data without any technological assistance. Another term for this power is Cyber Manipulation.

strengths: Never use a computer to go to Facebook, YouTube, etc.
Best way to cheat on a test
You're deadly in a computer store
weaknesses: You always start with control over data
You only shoot 0's and 1's at beginner's level
The virus in the cyber world might harm you in the real world

name: Gun Manipulation
description: For this power a gun is any weapon that has a trigger, fires bullets, and uses gunpowder or gas as a propellant. Thus an AK47 can be used but not a lasergun or crossbow. A low-level user of this power can create one gun at a time and is unable to control the gun while a high level user can create 1000 guns at a time and control each individually. This power can only be gained by hitting 1000 cans that are thrown into the air without missing a single can using a pistol. You are allowed to reload.
summary: The ability to create and control any gun
strengths: Can be very powerful at higher levels.
weaknesses: Very weak at first and this power does not give any boost to your aiming capabilities.

name: Weaponize
description: With this ability, you can effectivly turn anything into a "gun." By agitating the molecules in an object and causing them to explode in controlled, directed bursts. Bigger objects need more control to keep them from just exploding out in all directions.

strengths: Anything is a gun for you.
Never be unarmed
Two words: Building Gun
weaknesses: Might turn a necessary object into a gun
Hard to control with larger objects

name: Weapons From The Dark
description: You can turn your own shadow into weapons, both melee and long-ranged, such as swords or sniper rifles.

Strongest during the night
Nearly invincible in well shaded areas
weaknesses: Weapon may shatter depending on surrounding light
Weapon mass depends on shadow size
Weak against flashlights

name: Bio Enhancing Technopathy
description: A technopath has a great understanding of machines which would lead to huge advances in technology. Get the nanobots to rapidly build jet boosters into your feet or lasers into your eyes, or "repair" you. They could harvest metal from nearby or it could be stored within your body. Rapidly adapt to each situation and become a tactical war machine.

strengths: Easily enhance and repair yourself
Internal communications, internet, data storage etc
Many super-powers at your fingertips
weaknesses: May take concentration to organize large numbers of the nanobots
Requires an initial flair of invention and willingness to use self as a human guinea-pig

name: Program Creation
description: With this power, you can create any type of program that can do anything. I do not mean you can create a program that can manipulate reality or something. I mean you can create a program that can hack systems or manipulate systems. When I say, you can create any program I mean you think of it and it is created.

weaknesses: People might kidnap you to exploit your power.

name: Mechanic Kinesis
description: Ability to mental control and augment cars, augmentation would take a period of time depending on how the car is changed. The ability to change the form of their cars from guns to robots. The form appearance and abilities would be dependent on car. A mental connection with his would allow his body to be augmented by the abilities of one car at a time, but to a smaller degree. However, the number of cars he could control at one time would be limited. And his cars being damaged would reduce power

Different car for different situations
Can use the cars for combat
weaknesses: Powers rely on users cars being around

Number of cars able to be controlled at once is limited

name: Human Floppy Disk Drive
description: It's extremely rare to find a computer with a floppy disk drive nowadays. Mainly because we stopped using them. So, this power changes you into a human floppy disk drive. Just insert a floppy disk in your mouth. It allows to read the data contained in it. You can also format the disk, an important step for those data containers. And you can also save data on it, such as memories, thoughts, information, etc.
summary: The ability to read data contained in a floppy disk, format the floppy disk or save data on it.

description: If you have an eye thats dead, (right or left) doesnt matter which one. Then you could end up with this power. It's a mystery how you get it though. Anyway, that dead eye is regenated and from that point on your aim is perfect every time. If it is possible, you'll hit your target;  no matter how far or unlikely.Pefectly every time.

name: Computation
description:
People with computation could be the most accomplished people on the planet. They can solve complex equations and scenarios in their head, mimic movements with perfect precision, and have amazing memories.

Don't be misled. You cannot interact, merge, or control technologies, let alone surf the net.

Your body would be the hardware your brain's software commands. Vocal cords as speakers for example.

Some social awkwardness

name: Perfect Killer
description: With this power you can use everything as a lethal weapon. You can kill someone with a cheeseburger, or with a strawberry. Although, you can still miss and attack, so its not as powerful as it seems. This ability is more suitable for villains, and if you have the "can't miss" ability, or something like that, you are unbeatable.
summary: The ability to be able to use anything as a lethal weapon.
strengths: Makes you a powerful person, and you are never undefended.
If you have a "Super Human Aiming" ability, you are nearly unbeatable.
weaknesses: You are still a human.
This power is more suitable for villains.

name: Mechanical Arm
description: You can even have fictional technology or your own made-up technology. If there is a malfunction with a piece of technology, it will take up to one hour to be able to switch pieces of technology.
summary: The ability to turn your arms into any piece of technology
strengths: Your arms can be two different things
Can make your own pieces of technology and use them
weaknesses: If there's a malfunction, it will cost at most a 1-hour wait to change

name: Aura Injection
description: When you activate this aility any item you touch becomes injected with your aura. This causes it's form to warp, changing it into a weapon. The form and power of the weapon is largely based on the origional form of the item, and your aura. Because the warp depends largely on the type of aura you possess you can alter the end product. An example of which would be if you used this ability on a toy gun. You could shape it into a super powered shot gun, short range pistol, or a space cannon.
summary: The ability to inject your aura into an object through touch in order to turn it into a weapon of mass destruction.
strengths: Create weapons of mass destruction out of toys.
Depending on your mood, and intentions the objects affect changes.
This ability works on anything that can be used as a weapon, including rocks.
weaknesses: It takes a while to form the more complex weapons.
As soon as you stop touching the item it reverts.
You cannot create healing itmes.
