name: Emp Control
description: EMP control is a deadly ability, seeing that the world is overrun with technology. With this ablity one takes control over an EMP or Electromagnetic Pulse. This ability renders technogology useless. Knocks out street lights, sets off alarms, causing overloads at power plants, damages all electronic communication even to the point of creating a geomagnetic storm.
summary: The ability to have control of an EMP
strengths: Knocks out electronics
Can be concentrated to be in a certain area.
weaknesses: Deadly ability
Only effects electronics

name: Alien Equipment
description: With this power you can summon stereotypical alien equipment such as a UFO, ray gun, and cloaking device. While you may not know how the equipment works you have perfect knowledge of how to use the equipment. The alien equipment only works for the owner of this power. The type of equipment is not fixed, meaning you can change your UFO into a different type of UFO. When the object is summoned a green crop circle symbol appears in the air in the area where you are summon the item.
summary: The ability to summon stereotypical alien equpiment.
strengths: Have many different stereotypical pieces of alien technology.
Have your own personal, customizable UFO.
Alien technology is considered to be far more advanced than Earth's.
weaknesses: You do not know how to make the equipment, only use it.
The government will want to expirement on you.
Only get one of each piece of equipment.

name: Firearm Precision
description: With this ability, you always accurately fire guns. There are two limitations to this ability: 1. You must be able to see the target. 2. Your weapon isn't always as accurate as you are. If you're firing a pistol at a target a mile away, you're most likely not going to hit it. This ability applies to any firearm, Including flamethrowers, snipers, machineguns, bazookas, etc.
summary: The ability to fire guns with 100% accuracy.
strengths: Fire any gun with 100% accuracy.
This includes flamethrowers, bazookas, everything that goes bang with a trigger bro.
weaknesses: Your weapon may not be as accurate as you are.
You must be able to see your target.

name: Holographic Computer Display
description: The user of this power is able to access a holographic computer. The only parts that are visible are the screen, the keyboard, and touch sensitive pads. Anyone can see the computer but only someone who has this power can touch the computer. The computer acts like a high-tech model and can access the internet. The computer will always update to be the same as the best model possible.
summary: The ability to control a computer that is holographic anytime one wants
strengths: Free high-tech computer with internet access.
Takes up virtually no space and it can't be hacked or traced.
Parents can't put Parental Controls on the computer.
weaknesses: Don't even try using this power in combat.
Can't save files on to the computer.
Flash drives cannot access into the computer as there is no physical aspect to it.

name: Nanotechnosis
description: The tiny robots that you control can be programmed to build, destroy and cover yourself with metal
summary: The ability to control tiny robots
strengths: Can change anything metallic into something different, e.g. a car into a cannon.
Can have artifical abilities, e.g. super strong and fast
Can't get hurt by a high fall or a big explosion
weaknesses: Have to keep your memories in a computer
Can be hacked
Becomes weak when wet

name: Light Immunity
description: Light-based powers and techniques can't harm you but they can still help you.
summary: The ability to be immune to the harmful effects of light
strengths: Eliminates a weakness if you are a vampire.
Eliminates a good number of MythPowers from affecting you.
weaknesses: No, this power will not make you invisible (No Con Negation).
Darkness and shadow-based powers are not considered light-based by this power(No Con Negation).

name: Temporary Weapons Knowledge
description: With this power you have complete knowledge on a weapon and how to use a weapon, assuming a couple of conditions are met. One if that you have to be holding the weapon and the second is that you only have this knowledge while you're in danger. As soon as the danger is gone or you let go of the weapon you lose the knowledge.
summary: The ability to have complete knowledge of any weapon that you are holding while you are in danger
strengths: Knowledge of weapons
weaknesses: Only works while you're holding the weapon
Only works while you're in danger

name: Logical Object Placement
description: Running out of ammo,run into a gun shop and create more. Want free diamonds... A location could be a building or a base. The location must be active. You can't create tanks on a shutdown military base. You can't create gold watches in a empty store that that is going to be a watch store. If aliens had a hidden base on the Earth and you found it then you could create alien tech.
summary: The ability to create objects in locations where such objects could logically be found.
strengths: Find the right location and create what you need or want.
Fort Knox or a location where gold bars are made.
weaknesses: Locations can't be closed,destroyed or not yet open.
Some locations will have tough security.

name: Godslayer
description: A godslayer is usually a mortal man or woman who is granted the power to kill gods. However, the godslayer needs a source of power to draw from (Xena's daughter, Eve; Desak's amulet from Marvel comics) and they need a weapon in their possession. For every god, demon, or other mystic creature you slay, their power becomes yours!
summary: The ability to kill gods and take their powers.
strengths: Destroy the petty gods and make their power your own!
A mortal with an immortal life span.
I am Kratos, God of War!
weaknesses: You may be tempted to slay good gods as well (Thor, Amaterasu).
You may develop Kratos style bloodlust.

name: Animating Inanimate Objects
description: Where you ever too lazy to get ready for school in the morning?Well that is all in the past with this power. All you have to do is snap your fingers, and your toothbrush, clothes, and bed will do everything by themselves.
summary: The ability to bring objects to life.
strengths: Can be lazy all you want
If you are too drunk to drive, your car will drive for you
If n battle, you can bring to life any weapon to assist you in battle
weaknesses: Each object has a mind of it's own

name: Object Independence
description: This works in several ways. If it's just a power based in an object, you can just use that power at will. If the power really needs to manifest in an object (like infinite ammo guns), or if you want to, you can summon/disappear the object (if someone steals it, disappear it), or imbue any object of that type you handle with those properties. The final bonus is that you can summon many copies of the objects, with a limit you choose (usually, either time before it disintegrates or number of uses).
summary: The ability to take the powers from your object-powers and make them YOUR abilities
strengths: This happens automatically, so new objects are never at risk of being stolen before being transfered
Can still have neat tools by summoning them, but don't have to worry about theft
And you can still use those powers even if you don't want to have to lug around the object
weaknesses: This only works if it's an object with a power- not if it's a power to make an object
If this power gets perma-negated/stolen, all your objects suddenly spawn in the air around you
(Good because you don't lose them, bad because suddenly there's a bunch of weapons everywhere)

name: Hand Weapon
description: With this power, you can turn your hand into any weapon you want: shotgun, pocket knife, RPG, anything. But, it has to be a weapon, and if you have a gun, you don't have to put ammo in it!
summary: The ability to morph your hands into weapons.
strengths: No ammo needed
Just imagine all the weapons you can make
weaknesses: Can only make weapons
Some might look weird, like pocket knife, pistol, etc.

name: 3 To Get Ready
description: With this power you can be ready for anything just by snapping and saying the event you need to be ready for. Snapping and saying "Friend's wedding" will cause you to appear in a new tuxedo and a gift for your friend. Saying "Bear Attack" will cause you to know what to do if a bear attacks you and give you a weapon just in case. Saying "Science Fair" will give you a science project worthy of an A+/first place/blue ribbon. Saying "Math Test" will cause you to know all the answers to the test etc.
summary: The ability to get ready for any occasion just by snapping
strengths: You can be ready for anything
weaknesses: You can't use this power to get other super powers of any kind

name: Digital Mind
description: Also called Digital Mimicry or Mechanical Mind, this is the psychic mimicry of the electronic "thought" processes of a computer hard drive, allowing memory and data gathering, analysis and processing on par with, or beyond a supercomputer; can also be used to read bar codes/binary code like an actual language and to "borrow the senses" of machines designed to detect things (radar, GPS tracking, etc. ); in addition, the user's mind may be blocked from mental access by a password.
summary: The ability to psychically mimic the "thought" processes of a machine, most commonly a computer CPU
strengths: Human sonar, radar, GPS, motion detector, radio, iPod, audio recorder, surveillance camera,...
Very intelligent (analyze, process and remember information on par with a supercomputer)
Mind often protected by a password
weaknesses: If someone discovers your password (or you don't have one)
You are susceptible to normal viruses and diseases, but also computer viruses and worms
If your mind tries to process too much at once, you freeze like a computer

name: Deleted Information Accession.
description: With this power, one could give a phone temporary access to all data it ever stored, allowing access to deleted photos. If one applied the ability to a fellow human, that human would be able to recall any memory they had formed. This works best with touch, but more experienced users are not bound by this limitation.
summary: The ability to restore access to lost information.
strengths: Paired with other powers, such as telepathy, this could be extremely useful.
Once you have access, you can re-record that information.
Store a theoretically infinite amount of information on any device able to record data.
weaknesses: The target must have stored the information in the first place.
You cannot access the information yourself without compliance of the target or additional powers.
Effects are temporary; if not recorded again somewhere, the data will be lost again.

name: Melee Projection
description: You can point any melee weapon, ranged weapon, or whatever at anyone or anything, and "shoot" them with it, somehow creating an effect as if you had attacked with the item. However, it only has 75% of the normal effect, so it's better to "Double shoot". It also makes a gun-like sound, which is kind of cool.
summary: The ability to hit people with things without actually doing so
strengths: Hit hazardous things from long distance
Use fragile weapons without actually using them
Use melee weapons on enemies with ranged weapons from ranged distance
weaknesses: Only about 3/4 efficiency

name: Weapon Nut
description: With this ability you have the power to turn your hand into any weapon: hitting objects, swords, guns, bomb launchers, anything--just by thinking of the weapon you want at that moment.
summary: The ability to know everything about any weapon and turn your hand into a weapon at will.
strengths: Very useful in any kind of combat.
Every gun you want in just a blink away without carrying them.
weaknesses: When unstable or uncontrolled, you might get another weapon than the one you were thinking of
When in the wrong hands it can nuke the world or start a nuclear war.

name: Metal Heat
description: Ever walk into a bank robbery and the theif has a gun? Well you don't have to flip out any more if you have metal heat becase you can instantly melt your foe's gun or metal weapon before they have a chance to pull the trigger!
summary: The ability to melt metal at will, with your mind
strengths: No more people pointing a gun to your head.
No more watching scary movies and then feeling scared at night.
And mostly, no more freddy crugar!
weaknesses: If you have not mastered, you may melt your butter knife during dinner.

name: Mechanical Charging
description: Perhaps the perfect power for those who rely heavily on energy-run technology, this allows the user to charge energy-requiring machines with solely the power of his mind. One with this ability generates energy that can be used to charge batteries of anything from batteries of cell phones and TV remotes to cars, airplanes, robots and various other machines.
summary: The ability to use psychic power in order to charge machines
strengths: No need for a cell phone charger
Your car doesn't ever need gas to run (it'll run as long as you're in it)
You're a living battery (charging makes machines run longer than normal)
weaknesses: Only works on machines (not living beings)
Charge lasts a lot longer, but is not permanent
Charge often requires physical contact (and in weaker users, can actually drain the USER's energy)

name: Virus Master
description: You are the ultimate virus creator capable of creating and controlling any virus

Be the best hacker

Must infect people to have any power

name: Sensual Focuser
description: A person with this power can "hack" any person's senses causing them to only focus on one thing. For example you can cause it to only focus on pain so that anything that they sense will cause them pain and the pain felt will be magnified. You can also use this to focus on pleasure letting them be in a sense of ecstacy from just a simple touch. You can even make it do both at the same time---but that might drive them insane.

Increase their sense of pleasure so they want to get hit
Can also work on things that aren't the regular 5 senses
weaknesses: Can't think of any morally righteous uses of this power

name: Myth Power: Olympian Arsenal
description: Divine weapons, tools and items and attributes, in Greek myth, were quite numerous. As such, channeling them, one may summon Hades' cap (or helm) of invisibility; Poseidon's trident; Apollo and Artemis' bows and arrows; Athena's Aegis Shield (with Medusa's petrifying severed head on it); Hermes' winged sandals and hat; Pan's panpipes; Heracles' lion pelt (made from the Nemean Lion's impenetrable skin) and bow and arrows (dipped in Hydra poison), and numerous other tools and items at will.

Weapons are unbreakable
If lost, weapons can be recalled at will (or sent back to the box where items/tools are stored)
weaknesses: Only three weapons/tools can be summoned at one time (all tools/items of one god count as 1)
If used for evil (or the opposite of the desired god's alignment), the weapon disappears temporarily
Thanatos' Scythe can only be summoned at the higher levels (and not for long) (NCN)

name: Descriptor Addition
description: This is a power to transform things and people (including yourself), while keeping them the same actual person. You just add to its description! For example, have a butler? Make him a ninja butler! Or a ninja demon butler, or a ninja demon robot butler. Even if they don't already fit a category (like your friend is just a person, you could still add a descriptor). The descriptors can be basically anything, but this power keeps the inherent nature of the object.
summary: The ability to add descriptors to people or things

Unlike transmutation/transformation, you don't have to grapple with "Is it the same person? "

weaknesses: Less versatile than just pure transmutation/transformation
Can't just give someone any power directly- need an appropriate descriptor
(like robots may have strength, or demons demonic powers)

name: Movie Jump
description: A person with the power of Movie Jump can jump right in to any mass-produced film that's ever been created. Time in your own reality continues, like in that one episode of Charmed with the book in Magic School. Only one catch: you can't bring back anything that doesn't exist in the real world. Imaginary devices, tools, weapons, items of clothing, etc. cannot exist when you return to real life. Everything else is fair game
summary: The ability to travel into any film ever created.
strengths: Making tons of money from movies that contain wealth
Having so much fun with your favorite fictional characters
Leading a separate life within your power
weaknesses: No imaginary stuff (I know, sorry)
The power might destroy your real life, if you "jump" too often

name: Nano Gloves
description: This gloves consist of nanites, which makes it possible to turn them into anything - from a sword to a pair of pincers.
summary: The ability to have shapeshifting gloves on your hands.
strengths: You can use them in fights
You can use them to build or to repair something
weaknesses: Your gloves only work on your hands

name: Molecular Dispersion
description: The person with this power is able to disperse the molecules of an object, splitting them and dispersing them over space. For example, if this power is used on an enemies' gun , then the gun will disperse into nothingness. This power can only be used on non-living objects.
summary: The ability to disperse the molecules, splitting it and dispersing over space.
strengths: Can easily disarm an enemy
Can easily break down walls
weaknesses: Only can target non-living things
Cannot be used to fight powerhouses

name: Pixelation
description: Any size object can be created with the Pixel Staff, the item that creates it. Or, you can use what is called 'magic' on the hero's home planet, and create smaller objects if with out the staff. Mostly used as an assistance power, this power defeats and kills indirectly any foe of the hero. This can be stopped if the staff is broken and the hero's magic disabled, however is somewhat rare.

User can not lose potential to use staff, they can create a new one or fix the old one
weaknesses: Requires intense focus on Earth because atoms must be turned into pixels.
If copied by a villain or hero, it becomes a very difficult battle to win.

name: Electronic Machine Possession
description: On the verge of technopathic, you project your psychic spirit into electronics & machines & control them. You can even create & transform them into a humanoid creature. Your body will be left defenseless though & if an EMP struck while you possessed something, it could leave you in a coma.
summary: The ability to astrally project oneself to possess electronics & machinery
strengths: Possess & control electronic machinery
Combine & transform them into a humanoid
weaknesses: Body is defenseless
EMP could leave you in a coma

name: Technique Based Power Creator
description: A power technique is any way you use your powers to perform certain tasks. With this, whenever you master a technique, it can become an ability of its own. For example, with Telekinesis, you can train to get the power to propel anything. If you only lose Telekinesis, you'll still retain the power to propel things, but you won't be able to freely move them. If you only lose the propelling power, you can still propel things with Telekinesis but you'll be less proficient. This power is automatic.

strengths: The actual number of superpowers you have is higher than the ones you acquired.
There's no limit to how many techniques you can develop from a "root" superpower.
If you lose the "root" power, you'll still be able to use the techniques turned into superpowers.
weaknesses: You can't decide when a technique becomes a superpower and not all techniques can become one.

name: Reploid Power
description: Transform into a reploid like Zero or Megaman, complete with weapons and other equipment and abilities. Use everything as if it was your own. However, you are stuck with the transformation for a day before choosing another. If you die, you explode just like any other reploid.
summary: The ability to transform into a reploid.
strengths: Power of the reploids!
Increased skill in accordance to transformation.
weaknesses: If you die, you explode.
You're stuck in that transformation for a day.

name: Starships
description: With this power you can summon up to fifteen artificially intelligent starships. The starships have tons of weapons and defense mechanisms and can pilot themselves. They are also under your complete control and will do anything in their power to protect you from harm. If one of them gets destroyed you can summon a new one to take its place. You can also unsummon them and resummon them whenever you want.

strengths: You can summon a fleet of starships
They have tons of weapons
They're under your control
weaknesses: They're big so they can't help you if you're in an enclosed area
They can be destroyed

name: All Your Base Are Belong To Us
description: This ability is a truly hated one among those it affects. It allows one to entirely take control over nearly any system and make it YOURS. Literally. You can make it move, make it talk, access its information (thoughts and memories for living things, data for electronic devices) and command it verbally; and once you've dominated the system, you can assume control of it again, regardless of obstacles and distance.

strengths: Total body/system control (control almost any machine or creature)
Total body/system access (access any memories/thoughts/skills subjects possess)
Can borrow subjects' senses and abilities
weaknesses: Mind-control resistance prevents use of this power
Beginners in the use of this power have to actually SAY "All your base are belong to us"
Foes can keep from being controlled by saying "All my base are belong to me! "

name: Innate Language
description: If you have this ability, you automatically possess knowledge of a certain language or set of language. You may be fluent in the Romantic languages, German, Japanese, Computer-encrypted code or any other language that would not be innately possessed by people of your particular race (if you were Hispanic for example, you might possess innate knowledge of English or French); this usually implies any places that you'll visit in your life (when the situation arises, you'll be ready).

Get around in the country that speaks that language

If you're stuck in a situation or place where no one speaks that language

name: Counter
description: Your powered by your instinct to know your enemy's every move & successfully block & counter-attack them. You will even be able to disarm them when they hold weapons. This only works in close combat mostly.

strengths: Successfully block & counter attack an enemy
Disarm weapons easily
weaknesses: Only really works in close combat quarters

name: Weaponised Arms
description:
Having the power weaponised arms will allow you to morph you arms into any weapon you can think of. From swords, to spears, knives, daggers, etc to even projectile weapons from bows, crossbows to guns and heavy weaponry, it is all part of your arsenal.
With projectile weapons you will still need to load them with ammunition, your power does not produce this for you, but will morph a way for you to load the ammo.
summary: The ability to morph your arms into any weapon you can think of.

name: Game Master
description: Basically, you can win every game and know every trick of the game. It doesn't mater if the game is a board game, a computer game, or anything else. You also know all cheat codes.

Can win any game on your first try
weaknesses: People will get angry that they can't beat you
Can con people
Games can get boring

name: Automotaun
description: Automotauns were originally robots made by Hephaestus, but you were chosen by Hephaestus to work in his favor. In order for you to do so, he made you his human creation. Different metals give you different abilities, such as silver letting you reflect heat, but you are so genetically enhanced by the gods the metals increase by twenty percent. Hephaestus made you super smart which makes you able to understand and work for him. Lastly, you don't even have to breath.

Special powers from all metals

You serve Hephaestus

name: Society Improvement
description: At will, an event will cause the whole of human civilization to advance, such as a new advancement in technology, the slowing down of or end to world hunger, a peaceful and wise alien race visiting and sharing its knowledge for a time, a true uniting of nations and all the people of the world, etc. The person who has this ability is not affected by it, they must learn from other sources, such as people, books, and schools.
summary: The ability to cause the whole of society to advance intellectualy and morally.

World peace may eventualy be achieved.
Is the counter to Society Degredation.

name: Nuke

Destroy your enemy's hometown or fortress in an instant.
No one can stop you! Muhawhawhawhaw!
weaknesses: Can accidentally hut allies
Won't work on roaches
Need to point at an object far away.

name: Electronic Communication
description: A person with Electronic Communication is a recieving station for all manner of digital transmission--every IM, e-mail, and satellite transmission in the area is theirs to 'see' or 'hear'. Spy on governments or people

Intelligible range depends on strength of mind

name: Fix It
description: If you have a broken toaster or computer or car or anything else tech/mechanical, you will be able to restore it automatically to brand new. strengths: Fix any machine to brand new working order

name: Robot Clone Army
description: Once every 24 hours you can summon a robot that looks exactly like you. Has skin, and human eyes and hair. But inside is a titanium skeleton and cybernetics. The robots run on solar power, or can be charged through an outlet. They obey all commands with out question. Think Terminator 2 but looks like you.

Nearly indestructable.
So many good looking robots =D

name: Premonitious Touch
description: You can look into the future, past or present. This happens usually at random, but also when you touch something, like if you touched an old gun from a war, you would suddenly see a scene with someone holding it.

Find people.
Unaffected by time freezing.
