Uncontrollable.

name: The Panontic Arch
description: The Panontic Arch, an indestructible electro-mechanical device of unknown age and origin that, when set to a correct setting, will grant powers if you stand inside it. The two powers are based on what dimension the Arch was set to. Powers last 24 hours and any person can use the Arch three times a day. The Arch comes with an indestructible book made of metal, showing the symbols for each setting and name of the dimension. The language in the book will change so as to be readable by anyone.
summary: The ability to use a techno-mystical machine to gain powers.
strengths: Six selectable powers that last a day.
weaknesses: The Arch can be stolen, teleported or hidden by a foe.

name: Exploding Weapons
description: With this power you can make weapons that create explosions when they hit things out of nowhere. You can only create melee weapons such as swords, clubs, flails, maces, battle axes, spears etc. The explosions cannot hurt the person that uses the weapons only the person that the weapon hits.
summary: The ability to create exploding weapons out of nowhere
strengths: You can create explosion causing weapons out of nowhere
The explosions only hurt the person you hit with the weapon not the user
weaknesses: You can only create melee weapons no guns or bombs or stuff like that

name: Final Fantasy Weaponry
description: You can summon any weapon from Final Fantasy series to your aid and you can have only four weapons at time, but you can change the weapons any time. And you can also lend the weapons with your friends or teammates.
summary: The ability to summon any weapon from any Final Fantasy Series.
strengths: Weapons variables are great.
You can lend the weapons.
You can dual-wield weapons.
weaknesses: It has to be from Final Fantasy Series (Kingdom Hearts are included! )
It has to be different weapon (no duplicates! )
Dual-wielding makes you bit slow

name: Chromakinesis
description: The ability to change any color to any other color, not having to know names or computer values for the colors.
summary: The ability to manipulate colors.
strengths: Change your shirt design or your hair/eye color
Change the lens of a camera (or the enemy's eyes) to black to avoid detection.
Have lots of fun with this power
weaknesses: Not inteded for battle
Your friends will want you to do stuff for them

name: Weapon Capture
description: This power will allow you to take there ability and store it in the sword. But sadly only one ability will be stored inside the sword. Once more the ability has a cost each blade must take at least a finger but it would be weak. If you cut off say the arm t will be fully stored and fully at its full potential. Going with any weapon. You can use bladed cards basically anything can be turn into a weapon:D. Others wont be able to use the weapon.
summary: The ability to take anyone's power by a single strike.
strengths: Have the ability of others.
Can work with any weapon.
Limitless
weaknesses: Say if you have a bow and arrow only the arrow will absorb it
Cant work with any explosive and or gun.
Only one weapon can hold in one power.

name: Photoshop Reality
description: This applies to Photoshop and all similar programs. You will be able to alter reality by using the program on an image or photograph. The only limits are your imagination and skill with the program. Once you become very skilled with this, you will be able to create objects or even living things.
summary: The ability to alter reality by using Photoshop
strengths: Alter anything that you have an image of
Skilled users will be able to create objects and living things
weaknesses: You need a computer and the program to use it
Can take some time to do it right

name: Alternate Reality:Heroes Vault
description: With this power, you can access any weapon that was used by any hero or antihero in any timeline, by creating a downgraded copy from an alternate reality that gives you the same skills to wield it as the original user.  Also, you can transport people to your alternate reality to fight until someone dies. Weapons have all the effects given in myths and legends and also gives you access to the original user's memories.   Even modern heroes' weapons and tools can be copied.
summary: The ability to use any weapon or tool that was used by a hero or antihero with 90% the efficiency of the original
strengths: You can use a lot of weapons and tools (think Link, except you don't have to go through a dungeon)
You can create an alternate reality where you can use all your items with no time limit
weaknesses: Does not grant superstrength or speed, only the ability to wield the weapon
10 percent decrease inefficiency
Created weapons have a maximum staying time of 5 minutes outside the alternate reality

name: Cyborg Creator
description: With this power you can create cyborgs by fusing people with machines. You can do it with any person and any machine. You can fuse a person with a television set and be able to watch TV on their chest or merge a person with a telephone and cause them to be able to receive calls from their mind. Or to create a more conventional cyborg you could merge a person with a robot. You cannot control the cyborgs that you create but you can reverse the merge whenever you want.
summary: The ability to fuse people with machines
strengths: You can create cyborgs
You can undo the merge whenever you want
weaknesses: You cannot control the cyborgs you create
The cyborgs you create might get angry at you for horribly fusing them with machines

name: Transformutation
description: Basically, this power lets you give life and transforming ability to any mechanical or electrical device. You are essentially a selective "All Spark". The transformers you create are at your command, becoming your trained pets. Like pets, however, they must be cared for and taught how to behave, otherwise they revert to their natural "good" or "evil" base.
summary: The ability to turn any mechanical or electrical device into a Transformer.
strengths: You can have your own personal robotic bodyguard anytime you want.
Turn your car into battle-ready warrior - who can then turn into a better car!
You can have many smaller pets that will do your mischievious bidding.
weaknesses: Bigger transformers tend to be accidentally destructive. Your car might sit on your house!
Un-cared for transformers could turn against you.
Too many transformers might be hard to manage.

name: Ability Detection
description: Ability Detection is like a metal detector mixed with an X-ray machine and wrapped in radar. It allows the user to detect superhumans, know their ability, and even how powerful they are. It is difficult to jam or redirect, and can even be used to track down a specific ability. However, it does have a limited effective range of 100 miles.
summary: The ability to sense the whereabouts of superpowered individuals
strengths: Be aware of the approach of potential threats
Know if someone has an ability and what it is
Can be used to track down a specific power
weaknesses: Does not work on normal humans, no matter how dangerous they are
Limited effective range of 100 miles
No offensive capabilities

name: Remote Battle Armor
description: You posses a highly advanced battle armor that can be controlled from any distance.  The remote controller is a helmet. That helmet reads your mind to give you perfect control over it's movement and the weapons build into the armor.  It also makes you see/hear/sense everything that the armor experiences. When the connection is lost a limited AI will activate.  This AI will act based on pre-programmed instructions. For example: flee from danger, self-destruct, return to base, ...
summary: The ability to remotely control an advanced battle armor
strengths: The battle armor can be rebuild and upgraded to prepare for any challenge.
Damage to the armor doesn't hurt you.
The armor isn't bound to human limitations. (massive G-force, visual spectrum,... )
weaknesses: While in control of the armor you still need to protect your own body.
Disruption of the signal between the armor and the controller could be a problem.
Martial artists might see you as a coward because you don't face danger directly.

name: Mmo Grab
description: Wow,Wizard101,and Rumble fighter Wouldn't you wish to have those exocores,or powerful pets or spells,or that awesome sword you got on a raid in real life? Now you can with Mmo grab. You just find the weapon in your game. Put your hand on the computer screen,and it will phase through to let you grab the weapon,and the weapon transforms into what the weapon would actually be like no 5 inch sword a 5 ft sword
summary: The ability to grab any item or weapon from mmorpg's
strengths: Have any mmorpg weapon
Never get mocked again cause your mockers will fear your mighty sword
You will be the champ in mmo conventions
weaknesses: Theres no bad things have fun

name: Mech Summoning
description: You summon a mech (a large robot that you get in and pilot) or power armor (a mechanical suit enhancing the abilities of the wearer). You also gain all the skills necessary to pilot it (others can use them, but they don't get the skills). You can summon as many mechas in general as you want, but if there are a specific number of them in the fictional universe, then you can only summon that many of it at a time. If you need any special abilities to pilot it, you gain those, and can pass them on.
summary: The ability to summon a fictional mech
strengths: GIANT. ROBOTS. Or, if tearing up a city doesn't suit you, you can always do power armor.
If some work allows customization and has the rules for it (like a game), you can make your own.
If you give a mech to someone willingly, you can shut it down, destroy it, or unsummon it at will.
weaknesses: Only published series get free reign. Fiction published on the Internet only allows balanced mechs.
Mechs can get stolen. You'll have to touch them (skin-to-metal) or destroy them to unsummon.
If you can't get into them. Also, if your powers are weakened, most mechs will probably collapse.

name: T Vportation
description: With this power you can pull any object or person out of a TV program at will!  Great tools and experts are available with a click of your remote and your TVportation power!  Once you have the object, it's yours to do with what you want.  The person or character is at your service and must do as you wish.  You're limited only by your imagination and channel selection.  The objects and characters go back when your show is over.....
summary: The ability to pull anything or anyone out of a TV show
strengths: Just about anything is available - even fantasy objects and characters
Unique power!
Recorded shows work, too!
weaknesses: Limited only by the length of the show:  30 min or 60 mins, etc.
People might not understand your choices

name: Power Encryption
description: With this power, you can think of any power you have (including this one) and a series of letters and/or numbers. Once this "encryption" is done to a power, it can't be copied or altered. Powers can be stolen, but unless the power thief knows the access code, they can't use it. Encrypted powers can't be shared willingly even if you wanted to no matter what power sharing powers you have.
summary: The ability to encrypt your powers so they can't be copied or altered.
strengths: Keep the best powers to yourself.
weaknesses: You have to choose between sharing powers with your friends or encrypting your powers
Mind readers.
Remembering access codes if you have too many powers.

name: Loading Is Overrated
description: You have two pistols with magic cartridges that contain an infinite number of bullets. You just shoot and shoot and never have to load.
summary: The ability to have two guns with infinite bullets.
strengths: Ultimate pistol hero
Bang-bang, with both of your hands
You can always protect yourself
weaknesses: It's just two pistols, not a weapon of mass destruction
Your bullets are easily identifiable, so beware of detectives
Not so badass if you get so trigger happy that you accidentally kill someone innocent

name: Bs
description: Ever wanted to BS your way on an essay to a test and get a 100? Well, now you can! This useful ability lets anything you put on paper--or on the computer screen, or even any lies you make, sound perfectly true even if they are BS!
summary: The ability to bs your way out of anything
strengths: Anyone will believe what BS you tell them
You can BS really well
You get better with practice
weaknesses: Not really useful if you're a superhero

name: Rinnegan: Samsara Eye
description: If you are born with this special ripple like eye, than you are able to control all jutsu and master them easily. Although this is inherited, one must at least look at one technique to know how it functions
summary: The ability to control all kinds of jutsu with this special eye
strengths: Almost all jutsu is yours to master and make your own
You will be able to graduate from the ninja academy with ease
You can use a jutsu for every situation
weaknesses: You have to see the jutsu, being blinded negates the learning ability
You can't learn about abilities that are faster than you can see them
Invisible jutsu because you can't see them

name: Crystal Brain
description: The crystal brain is a gem containing massive intellectual power. Anyone in possession of the crystal brain can put it inside a golem, a robot, or any inorganic person to make it smart. It can also turn a dumb person intelligent by simply letting them hold it.
summary: The ability to place an intelligent crystal into a golem or suit of armor in order to animate it
strengths: It can erase a person's dumbness
Can put it inside a Golem's head to turn it intelligent.
weaknesses: It might be smarter than you

name: Sharpener
description: A person with this power can make anything as sharp as a blade and have extremely sharp edges. When used on a plastic knife, it becomes sharp enough to count as a real knife, and sharpening your own body lets you defend against steel weapons. You can even sharpen objects not on your body through concentration. You can sharpen the handles of a person's gun or sword to make them drop their weapon, or, if desired, sharpen their clothes to create lacerations.
summary: The ability to make anything have edges as sharp as a blade until deactivated
strengths: Make people drop weapons
Strengthen bladed weapons easy
No need to buy scissors or knives when your body is sharp enough
weaknesses: When people touch you when you are sharp-when they are not your enemies
Accidentally cutting yourself

name: King (Or Queen) Of Balance
description: Ever had the feeling where you lose your balance for no reason? Well, this power allows you to cause that exact feeling on others. With a flick of your hand, enemies will topple like dominoes and have no clue why they suddenly lost their balance. At the beginning, it is difficult to control.
summary: The ability to alter people's sense of balance
strengths: If an enemy has a gun or something else, they need to concentrate to use. You can cause them to miss
It's good fun to use on friends
weaknesses: You are still human and can still get hurt if things don't work out.
It is difficult to control to begin with and you may find it happens more to you than others

name: Swiss Army Gun
description: The Swiss Army Gun is a multi-function pocket Gun-handle; it has an amount of various projectile weapons such as a pistle, normal/ sniper rifle,grenade/missile launcher, water/ray gun, and Gatling gun. Each weapon comes with a full clip of ammo when it is summoned but you must switch weapons when it runs out of ammo to get ammo back. Based on Amalgamer's Swiss Army Saber.
summary: The ability to use it to switch to different guns within it.
strengths: Can switch between weapons instantly and store as just the handle when not in use.
Has large variety of projectile weapons including fictional ones.
Useful for changing strategies and confusing opponents.
weaknesses: Has limited ammo but ammo can be reloaded when weapon is switched.
Need good aim and practice with each weapon.
Projectile weapons for this power does not include things such as bow and arrows.

name: Murphy's Law
description:
When a person is using this power, they can make anything go wrong by thinking about it as long as they can determine a fatal flaw in something's design. 

This can work on any design from robots to someone's plan
summary: The ability to make anything that can go wrong go wrong
strengths: You can make things malfunction by analyzation-pointing out flaws make things malfunction
Very few designs can be without flaws or possible mistakes.
weaknesses: If this power is accidentally used on yourself making things worse for yourself
If someone was able to cover all the flaws you can think of
If you can't find a visible flaw in a person's plan or design

name: Hacker's Touch
description: Hackers are people who are extremely curious, sneaking into people's lives and learning everything they can, but they never use this information to their advantage. You have the Hacker's Touch. Whenever you touch someone with your bare hands (only works with your hands), you can learn everything about them besides their future. The limitation is, if you use this to your advantage, you will lose the ability and the information. However, you can use this ability to help the person you learn about.
summary: The ability to have the Hacker's Touch.
strengths: Learn things easily.
Satisfy curiosity.
Can help others.
weaknesses: Can't take advantage of the information.
Have to wear gloves to avoid accidental contact.

name: Fingerprint Database
description: With this power, you are a human fingerprint database. Whenever you see a fingerprint, you will instantly know who it belongs to, and you can even sketch a copy of any person's fingerprint.
summary: The ability to know the owner of a fingerprint when you see one
strengths: You are a walking, talking fingerprint database.
You can sketch exact copies of human fingerprints.
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat.

name: Goldworks: Army Of Gold
description: Long ago, there was a ancient civilization whose name was lost to time. They had knowledge & technology far beyond other empires. After 700 years of peace, that civilization was torn apart by a civil war that killed hundreds of thousands of citizens. In the end, the emperor used what was left of their technology to create a golden crown. This crown had the incredible power to control the skeletons of the falling citizens, which had also turned to gold. The skeletons are under the wielder's power
summary: The ability to wield the Crown of the Golden Dead
strengths: Controlling an army of golden undying skeletons with a golden crown.
When you need them, the skeletons will rise from the ground to help and serve you
The skeletons can repair themselves when needed
weaknesses: The crown can be lost and used by others.
The skeletons are no stronger or faster than other beings

name: Mjollnir
description: Use Mjollnir to break mountains or crack some skulls. You have the ultimate weapon. No godling, alien, man or beast can withstand a blow from it. If you throw it Mjollnir will always hit its mark and always return to you. You can make enemies think you are weaponless by hiding it in your tighty whiteys. Then whip it out (the hammer) and beat the snot out of them. You are almost immortal while Mjollnir is yours.
summary: The ability to carry the mighty hammer of a thunder god
strengths: Sword in the stone rule: only you can lift Mjollnir
Eventually control lightning, fly, teleport thru an astral realm and ride giant goats, yeah goats
You'll be 7 ft tall with long curly red hair, massive muscles, superstrength and a love of violence
weaknesses: Dragons, cross-dressing murderous trickster half-brother/sister, frost-giants, and dark elves
You'll have to die a warrior's death or no burning boat funeral or Valhalla for you
Ragnarok will happen on Earth as long as you possess the hammer and you will not survive

name: Dagger Wrist
description: When used it will make a slit in your wrist (it wont hurt). And a dagger chain will come out. It can hurt you but it is indestructible,And can support any weight so you can swing on it.
summary: The ability to summon a dagger chain out of your wrist
strengths: Have a weapon in any situation
Swing off the dagger-tail
Completly concealable
weaknesses: The slit wont hurt but the dagger will
If you bring it to a gun fight
You have to practice

name: Auto Desk
description: When you are having trouble you can pull up this smart computer and ask for a resolution. This power really helps with problem solving and you can even ask it to create an acual object of your design.
summary: The ability to make a levatating touchscreen smart computer pop up
strengths: Have infinite info at your fingertips
Can cheat on any test
Can show up on your eyes instead of in front of you
weaknesses: Can attract viruses
Can crash
Can't use without special fingertips (need to do ritual)

name: Mechanical Imperceptibility
description: A person with Mechanical Imperceptibility has a strange gift. No machine can register their presence--radar, infra-red detectors, even household cameras. They simply do not show up on film. This aura can be extended to up to twice your body mass. However, it cannot be turned off and secondary effects still show up (doors opening, footprints, etc.).
summary: The ability to be undetectable to machines
strengths: Unable to show up on cameras
Unable to be heard on recordings
Can be extended to twice your body mass
weaknesses: Secondary effects still show up (doors opening or closing)
Not invisible to people
Cannot be turned off

name: Blind Faith
description: This is power to hit any target but you have to be blind or keep your eyes closed. You have to have faith that it will work. Any doubt in your mind makes you miss. Works best with knives and throwing objects. Guns not so much.
summary: The ability to hit targets while blinded
strengths: You can take down a bad guy who has a hostage in front of him easily every time.
Parties with always be fun.
If you get blinded did ng a fight you're NOT helpless.
weaknesses: Doubt makes you miss and you become useless.
If you're not blind, opening your eyes too soon will male you miss.
Looking away from targets doesn't count as closing your eyes, kill unnecessarily when ya mess up.

name: Power Hacker
description: This person can hack into anyone's power (via telepathy) similar to that of a computer. Once this person has hacked into a power they can do almost anything to it. They can copy, steal, deactivate, activate, alter, erase, transfer, and swap any power they are hacked into.
summary: The ability to to hack into anyone's power.
strengths: You can acquire multiple powers.
You can turn your enemies power off.
You can hack into one of your own powers.
weaknesses: You need to be within sight of the person being hacked.
Each hack takes 1 minute to hack into a power.
You are vulnerable to attack while hacked into a power.

name: Myth Power: Athena's Ethic
description: Athena (Athene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of wisdom, war, civilization and arts and crafts. As such, channeling her allows one to gain Superhuman Intelligence and Wisdom. In addition, one gains skill in various arts and crafts (weaving/sewing, pottery, martial arts, etc), as well as inventing, using and improving technology. Furthermore, one can psychically change one's clothes into armor, and belongings into tools/weapons, at will. One can even gain physical power to help others in need.
summary: The ability to channel Athena's command over the essence of wisdom, war, civilization and crafts
strengths: Gain Superhuman Intelligence and Superhuman Wisdom; gain skill in various arts and crafts
Psychically change one's clothes and belongings into indestructible weapons/armor
Gain physical power to help others in need; gain fighting/weapon skill
weaknesses: Part 1 of Pro #3 requires that others be in need; no Hero Sense until developed (NCN)
Tend not to get along with people with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige
Spiders don't act favorably toward you (NCN)

name: Tron Collection
description: With this power you can summon and know how to use any of the gadgets from Tron, including the Tron suits and Light Cycles. This power can also summon Tron related items, such as a Tron themed watch, laptop, or figurine. The summoned items can be used by anyone. To unsummon an object, you must come into physical contact with the item you summoned.
summary: The ability to summon and use anything related to Tron.
strengths: Have access to Tron weapon and vehicles.
Can summon Tron related items and give/sell them.
Have knowledge of how to use the items from the Tron world.
weaknesses: The items can be stolen.
Everyone you know will want free Tron items.
Have to touch the objects to unsummon them.

name: Order Magnification
description: This power has amazing potential if used correctly. The user can drastically reduce the amount of randomness of objects by touch--block towers reassemble, scattered cards come together in the correct order, crumbled walls become pristine. This also works with mixtures and solutions, can serve to prism white light, and spread out heat over a wide area. This ability is not permanent--objects can be degraded--and it is dependent on will.
summary: The ability to decrease the amount of randomness in a given set of objects
strengths: Reassemble shuffled decks or puzzles
Works on many things--crumbled walls, chemical solutions, light, etc.
Incredible potential
weaknesses: Cannot increase randomness
Effects are not permanent
Not very effective without much practice

name: Informational Imprint
description: Informational Imprint is a subtle power, but can be used for great effect. By holding an object (pencil, shovel, gun) in their hand and focusing, they give it a 'cloud of knowing'. The result? Whoever picks up the object gets hit with the information you stored. This can be used to create pencils that 'know' what you've studied, weapons that 'tell' the wielders how to fight with them, and even instructionless MREs (meals ready to eat). The downside is you can only imprint what you already know.
summary: The ability to imbue inanimate objects with an aura of knowledge
strengths: Can impart pencils with the test answers
Can make weapons that 'know' how to be handled
Works for anyone
weaknesses: Only one imprint an object
Can only imprint what you already know
Works for your enemies too

name: The Emperor's Code
description: This power let's you influence and control people below you in social status. To influence people, simply shake their hand, and they will agree with your ideals. To control people, simply make eye contact and they are under your control. You can still lose minions by being humiliated in front of them
summary: The ability to gain control of people who are socially under you
strengths: If you are king, you can control everyone in your kingdom
Your controlled minions don't care about their needs
Even being middle-class grants you minions
weaknesses: If you are in poverty, this does nothing
If you are humbled, degraded, or fired, you lose control
Raising your class is difficult work

name: Physical Harm Virus
description: This power allows you to infect people you touch with a virus that makes any wounds they have pass onto people they touch. These infected people will pass on the virus and their injuries to others they touch as well. People with this power are immune to the virus until they lose the power, have the ability to pass the virus on completely, or can cure it. The virus can be cured magically. Virus can pass through gloves, safety suits, and other clothes.
summary: The ability to pass on physical harm by touch like a virus
strengths: Infect people at will.
Cure infected people.
Become immune to virus if you have this power
weaknesses: May infect people you do not wish to have infected.
Virus may grow out of your control. More people infected than you can cure.
Virus remains in dead bodies so fatal wounds can be passed on.

name: Four Eyes: Scan
description: This power is gained by having the Four Eyes power and having only the two abnormal eyes open. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power. You can look at an opponent with all four eyes and find out something random about them. This happens magically and might be something even they are unaware of about themself. It takes around 1-2 seconds to get the information though. You can with a lot of training focus the information on what you consider useful.
summary: The ability to scan an opponent to find out data about them
strengths: Can find out an opponent's weaknesses.
Can still use the Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and have the two normal eyes closed while the other two eyes are open.
Data is random and might be useless. Ex: Has 100 fireflies in a jar.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Transformers: Laserbeak
description: With this power you can generate high powered laser guns on your wrists. The guns can also detach from your wrists and fly around and shoot lasers at your dissection. A side effect of this power makes you a fan of birds.
summary: The ability to have two flying laser shooting drones
strengths: You can generate flying laser shooting gun drones
weaknesses: They can be destroyed
You are now a fan of birds

name: Steampunk Hero
description: You can easily construct steam-operated weapons. You also have a vast knowledge about mechanics and engineering. When activated, your arm will transmute into a larger steam-operated saw, firearm, etc. Your arms and legs can also function as pistons for infinite swinging or running power. If your selected weapon breaks, you can produce another; your weapons never overheat. You can synthesize other metals with your weapons for better durability and performance.
summary: The ability to produce machinery that operates on steam.
strengths: A giant power saw that can easily topple trees; timber!
Your "piston fist" leaves craters in skulls and other worthless pieces of junk.
Releasing steam is optional.
weaknesses: There's no use to being a Steampunk Hero without an imagination.
Some metals are completely useless to synthesize.
Watch your aim with your "revolver knuckle"

name: Artifact: Sceptrum Virtuale
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a staff appears that can be used to control and hack anything on the Internet. You can also use it to enter the Internet as a spirit. While in "cyberspace", you have seven mice minions that can help you hack and control the Internet. It can also be used on other electronic devices.
summary: The ability to summon a staff that can be used for electronic purposes.
strengths: The staff can also be used for magic.
Can hack data, passwords, and do whatever you want with the Internet.
weaknesses: When in cyberspace, your actual body is in the real world and unconscious.

name: Pistol Master
description: A Pistol Master is a person that can pick up a pistol and be a master of it without even having to see before. You can curve bullets, have pin point accuracy, and perfectly modify your weapon better than anyone else would be able to.
summary: The ability to be a master of any pistol known to man
strengths: No more hiding behind walls for enemies
You can have the greatest pistols ever and not have to train
weaknesses: Pistols don't have that long of a range
Drop your pistol you're dead

name: Mini Plane Drone
description: You will be able to summon a mini plane that can fight using laser guns, rocket launchers, and extenting arms.
summary: The ability to summon a miniature plane that can fight for you.
strengths: Able to slip through radar.
weaknesses: All of the weapons are miniature to, so it has a little less than average damage rate.

name: Even Weaponry
description: When faced with an armed opponent, using this ability will create copies of their weapons for you. However, if you are also armed, duplicates of your weapons will be created for them. The duplicates are exact copies of the original ones, even in terms of supernatural abilities. If the original weapon has some sort of supernatural allegiance with its owner, the duplicates will also have one with its new owner. If an original weapon is lost or abandoned by its owner, its copy will disappear.
summary: The ability to possess exact duplicates of one person's weapons, while allowing them to have duplicates of yours.
strengths: Against supernatural weapons or some Ability-Imbued objects used as weapons.
You can only target one person, but that person doesn't have to be your opponent.
If your opponent is gaining the upper hand with your weapon, you can always cancel this power.
weaknesses: Giving an opponent supernatural weapons or some Ability-Imbued objects used as weapons.
Sometimes, it's not the weapon itself that's important, it's how you use it.
Copies will vanish if the original ones are lost or abandoned. Even copies of ammunitions.

name: Shifting Jewels
description: To be exact, the holder of this power creates jewels that are surrounded by a thin setting of gold, silver, brass, or another metal. The metal is what transforms at its owner's will into a specific object chosen at the creation of the jewel. The jewel holds the data on what the metal transforms into and each jewel can only hold one form's worth of data. The form can be anything the same size as or smaller than a suit of armor with wings.
summary: The ability to create jewels that transform into other objects
strengths: Can create deceptively noncombative jewellry that transforms into weapons, armor, or shields.
Only transforms at the OWNER's will, not even the maker's will (good selling point though).
Con: Con Negation and alteration powers will NOT get rid of the cons in this power.
weaknesses: Only one chosen object per jewel. Chosen object cannot be changed once decided on.
The item that the jewel's setting transforms into cannot be bigger than a suit of armor with wings.
Have to use a jewel that already exists when using this power.

name: Robot Transformation
description: This power allows the user to become a robot, turning his/her skin into titanium and armed with wrist mounted machineguns, eye and finger lasers, shoulder mounted missile launchers, and a powerful chest mounted energy cannon. Also, in robot form, the user has flight capabilities courtesy of a jet pack installed in his/her back. The user can only revert back to human form if he/she runs out of power or ammunition.
summary: The ability to become a heavily armed and armored robot
strengths: Destroying all your opponents with just one barrage of all your weapons
Become the ultimate hybrid of human and machine
No one will beat you in "robot dancing" because you are a robot
weaknesses: EMP waves and other machine stopping devices can disable you in robot form
When in robot form, you have no emotions or any kind of feelings at all
Running out of energy or ammunition

name: Batman Utility Belt
description: With this power you have Batman's utility belt and all of its gadgets including batarangs, bat-lasso, bat-cuffs and other assorted bat themed weapons and gadgets. When you use this power the belt instantly appears around your waist and when it is taken off it disappears until you summon it again. You also are unable to use any kind of gun or firearm while wearing the belt.
summary: The ability to have Batman's utility belt
strengths: You have batman's utility belt and all of his gadgets
weaknesses: You can't use guns when you're wearing the belt

name: Mystic Spinner
description: This power will allow you to make things that you throw spin. You can throw any throwing weapons at your opponent and make it spin just by thinking. The faster you spin it, the greater the force of the impact will be.
summary: The ability to make anything you throw spin just by thinking.
strengths: Add more power to anything you throw.
weaknesses: You need to have a great accuracy in order to hit your target when you throw something

name: Adrenaline
description: Adrenaline is a very dangerous power. You can send others into a crazed frenzy and they would kill themselves if you wished them to be killed. You are nearly unstoppable with Adrenaline. Your eyes begin to glow a strange color and your senses highten. If you do not master this power quickly, it could be your death. If you use this power too often, you could become stuck in your Adrenaline mode. Your only instinct is to kill.
summary: The ability to make yourself into an unstoppable killing machine and send others into a frenzy
strengths: You can make threats to kill people and actually carry the deed out.
You can send others into a frenzy.
You could rule the world.
weaknesses: This power eats your soul a little bit every time you use it.
Turning it on and off as you please comes with a great amount of time and effort.
You can't think clearly. You don't know who you're killing until you manage to turn it off.

name: Genie
description: You're not stuck in a lamp, but you are bound to grant a person's wish. Just one wish and it can be almost anything, except to have infinite or more wishes or to become a reality-warping "genie". The good part is that you're technically an all-powerful demi-god. The downer is you're a servant demi-god that has to do what others tell you to do, unless they wish to free you from your bounding power and make you normal, and you can't make wishes for yourself. So be careful what you wish for ;D
summary: The ability to grant reality-warping "wishes".
strengths: Be an all-powerful reality-warping demi-god.
weaknesses: Bound to serve other people's wishes.
Can't make your own wishes.
Person has to say "I wish" and can only have one which does come with rules.

name: Divination
description: Every culture has a Diviner. Divining is a form of Precognition that is dependent on a tool like tarot cards, reading fox tracks, tea leaves, and things like that. This is easier to access than Precognition, but  you need your chosen tool to use it.
summary: The ability to determine future events by using cards, crystal balls, etc.
strengths: Predict the future with eerie accuracy
Easy to find tarot cards, tea leaves, etc.
Usually become very trusted in a community
weaknesses: Need a tool to tell the future by
Bad fortunes
Being "Johnny Raincloud"

name: Weapons In Disguise!
description: Turn grenades into pens, tanks into backpacks, and much more!
summary: The ability to turn weapons into casual items.
strengths: If you can remember to bring a grenade but not a pen.
weaknesses: Basically useless.
This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Dismantle
description: With this ability, you can pull apart any mechanical device. You won't have to worry about making a mistake, because you won't. Hesistation won't be factor either. E. G. - You can dismantle a bomb without pulling the wrong wire, and you can do it within the time-frame.
summary: The ability to pull apart any mechanical device.
strengths: Pull apart any mechanical device, without making a mistake.
Dismantle a bomb within the alotted time-frame.
Those with technology-based powers will fear you.
weaknesses: Don't have the power to put the machine back together (be careful with your car).

name: Dagger Of  Sacrifice
description: (This dagger is one of the darkest weapons ) this dagger was saw evil that the very name of it was seen as a sin. This dagger was mad from the Judas chalice. Only a servant of god can destroy this dagger.
summary: The ability to posses a dagger that can absorb peoples soul by stabbing
strengths: Scare people to death
Sweat revenge
You are the evil assassin
weaknesses: The Vatican will hunt you done ( be afraid )
It can only absorb peoples soul ( no con negation )
Only a servant of god can destroy this dagger

name: The Handyman
description: You can unscrew screws, fasten nuts & bolts, and hammer away. Anything that you can find in a garage that fits in your hand, you can just do WITH your hands (within reason). Life would be oh so much easier.  As a bonus, your hand can also be used as a power drill.  Now that's pimped.
summary: The ability to use your hands as any kind of tool, including a power drill!
strengths: Never have to purchase tools
Fix your car almost entirely with your hands
Could be useful skills for other areas of your life
weaknesses: You can still hit your thumb

name: Cyborg Transformation
description: This power counts robots covered in flesh(The Terminator),a mechanical shell giving life support and/or mobility(i. E. A dalek,a cyberman or Darth Vader) or someone partly organic,partly mechanical(DC Cyborg, a borg or Darth Vader-again). If a borg you could assimilate others but be confused as you have no collective. Being Darth Vader gives you force powers. Technology powers will be your bane.
summary: The ability to become any cyborg from any source(comics,tv,books,etc).
strengths: You will assimilate others.
You will use the force.
A single dalek is very tough to defeat.
weaknesses: Any cyborg will have aspecific weaknesses or at least a one weakness.
Technology powers will stop or control you.
Electromagnetic pulse powers.

name: Nanite Biomechanicality
description: The overview says it all. With this power you have Generator Rex's(Rex)powers. Every time a new power is discovered by Rex, you get it. You can discover new machines. Sometimes you turn into Rex's EVO form. But you still keep your memory.
summary: The ability to have all of Generator Rex's powers
strengths: Rex makes extremely powerful machines
You can discover machines.
Sometimes a control nanite activates and con 1 is inactive
weaknesses: Rex's powers sometimes don't work when you get angry
In EVO form you lose control.

name: Interdimensional M Gun Monster
description: You need to read the power "Interdimensional Hand Monster" to understand this power. This is a similar power, but instead, it involves a machine gun. When you activate this ability, a machine gun will materialise in your hands. You start by shooting many rounds of nothing. You will in fact be shooting many small yellow monsters in quick succession. Each monster will take the target into another dimension, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
summary: The ability to fire many small monsters in quick succession using a special machine gun
strengths: Fire many small monsters quickly at a target.
No precision required; Just aim at the general direction, you're bound to hit something.
Not lethal.
weaknesses: Bounces off walls.
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Scares people.

name: Arcana: 2 The High Priestess
description: This power gives Procedural Knowledge, or "How-To" knowledge. It gives you expert knowledge and muscle memory without you ever even so much as seeing something done. You could learn how to throw a curve ball or how to operate a machine gun. This ability will often give information that is useful, but not always for the current situation. The only real limits to this power are that you can't learn how to do the physically impossible or do something without the things required to do it.
summary: The ability to gain random knowledge.
strengths: Can gain any kind of how-to knowledge.
Might gain the how-to knowledge of a martial art expert.
Can activate at will.
weaknesses: Never gives you what you want to know.
Can't do something impossible, or directly gain superpowers.

name: Super Forget
description: With this power whenever you point at somebody they forget what they were doing when you pointed at them. So if your enemy is building a weapon of destruction or aiming a gun at your head or something you can just point at them and they will forget about it. You can do this as many times as you want to the same person or you can use it against a bunch of people by pointing at several different people.
summary: The ability to point at someone and make them forget what they were doing
strengths: You can make people forget what they were doing by pointing at them
weaknesses: Just because they forgot they were doing it doesn't mean they won't think of doing it again

name: The Colt
description: (This gun is very wear ) this looks like the colt M1892. This gun can kill all most anything. This gun has Latin inscriptions on it, it says I fear no evil. This gun can't kill Lucifer or god. This gun is deadly in the wrong hands. Know your history.
summary: The ability to summon a gun from 'Supernatural' that can all most kill anything
strengths: Can kill anything ( all most )
Looks cool
All shall fear you
weaknesses: It breaks
You will loose it eventually
Needs bullets

name: Figurine Army
description: The power can cause a bunch of pre-made lead figures to grow into full sized humans (or whatever). Any simple non-mechanical tools the figures may possess also become real. The figures are loyal, able to think for themselves, know how to use any tool or weapon they possess, and otherwise know anything their master knows.
summary: The ability to grow an army from little lead figurines
strengths: Unlimited number of allies
Not limited to fighters - workmen, cooks, homework writers,...
Can always make more, so expendable
weaknesses: Have to carry around large bag of figurines
No modern weapons or SF stuff.
You go down, they go down.

name: Music Synchronization
description: With this power you can do things associated with a song. For instance, the title of the song "Decode" would allow you to decode any code or password and/or do anything else associated in the lyrics. You can also transform into the artist if you know who sings the song. Also, you can do almost anything that was done in the music video (if there is one).
summary: The ability to do anything associated with a song, its artist, or video.
strengths: If you have a CD of the song, you grow stronger.
If you have the song on your iPod or music player, then you grow stronger.
weaknesses: You MUST know the name of the song, no matter what.
You CANNOT do anything EXTREME (like being God).

name: Weapon Soul
description: The next step up from "becoming one with your weapon", this power allows you to convert your entire body into a fully functional weapon: i.e., a scythe, a sword, a pair of nunchucks or even a gun.  The type of weapon you turn into is largely based on your soul and/or your history - for instance, a ninja could turn into a variety of ninja weapons, while a cowboy-type would probably turn into a revolver.  The drawback, of course, is that you can't use yourself - you need a partner to wield you.
summary: The ability to completely transform into any one specific weapon.
strengths: Partial transformations allow for unique attack/defense options
Full transformation could possibly allow for hiding in plain sight, depending on your weapon type
As a soul-based ability, your powers grow as you grow as a person
weaknesses: Of course, in full transformation, you need a partner to wield you, or you're useless
Sometimes partial transformations are awkward - imagine explaining your leg turning into a blade
If you are destroyed as a weapon, your soul is shattered, and you become unrevivifiably dead

name: Avaritia
description: This is a power that allows the user to create a powerful vacuum that can suck up anything. It's basically similar to a black hole. It's activated by using one's hands to create the vacuum(hole). Anything that is sucked into the hole can be used later on by the user, for example weapons or even people(as shields).
summary: The ability to create a vacuum that can suck up anything
strengths: Can suck up just about anything
Very powerful and hard to avoid
weaknesses: Hard to control and may inadvertently suck up something not intended
Has a time limit, doesn't last forever
Its power and size depend on the overall strength and ability of the user

name: Swiss Army Saber
description: The swiss army saber is a multi-function pocket sword-hilt; it has an amount of various blades such as broadsword, kriss, katana, scimitar, machete, drakesword, and kirehashi. It is approximately 96 mm (4.6) long.
summary: The ability to use it to switch to different blades within it.
strengths: Can definitely confuse your foes in combat.
weaknesses: None.

name: Vocal Sfx
description: A lot of sound effects can be reproduced with only the mouth and voice, sometimes the body. This power allows you to cause real effects when you produce them. For example, imitating an explosion SFX will cause one; a motorcycle SFX allows you to travel as if you were on a real one; a gunshot or machine gun SFX allows you to fire TK bullets; a ripping SFX can tear fabric. Keep in mind that you don't materialize things, you just make it seems like they are there and can act on their surrounding.
summary: The ability to create real effects based on the sounds you make with your mouth and voice.
strengths: This power is very flexible. You don't have to produce a perfect imitation of a SFX.
One SFX can be used for various effects. A metal impact can pound nails, deflect swords and more.
Since your power isn't "substantial", its effects can't be blocked by conventional means.
weaknesses: You have to learn how to produce sound effects. Just saying "BOOM" or "SCRATCH" won't work.
Only sounds produced with your own body works. For example, recordings don't work.

name: Transformers: Omega Supreme
description: With this power you can cause a high powered tank gun to sprout from your head. When you use this power your entire head becomes metal as well. The gun can shoot any type of ammo you want and can move to any spot on your head. A side effect of this power causes you talk like Omega Supreme (Speech patterns: Omega Supreme).
summary: The ability to cause a tank gun to sprout from your head
strengths: You can cause a tank gun to sprout from your head
Your entire head becomes metal (this does not hamper your breathing, sight, smelling or anything els
weaknesses: You talk like Omega Supreme when you use this power

name: Thirteen Treasures: Mantle
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This mantle grants the bearer invisibility from all eyes, while still allowing the wearer to view all others.
summary: The ability to wear the Mantle of King Arthur
strengths: If you so wish, you can pretend to be Harry Potter.
weaknesses: The books in the restricted section of Hogwarts will still scream when you open them.

name: Metallic Hair Alloy
description: The user is able to create a heavy duty sturdy titanium metal from their hair. This is telekinetic, so no words or spells needed. Think it and you can do it. When used as a weapon, the hair forms to the place you want it the most, i.e. if you wanted a sword, the hair would curl around your arms and form a sword. Same thing with a gun that shoots metal bullets. Limitation: You cannot create massive things, such as buildings or houses. If you have any questions, contact me for better explanation.
summary: The ability to create a titanium metal from your hair
strengths: Guns have unlimited ammo since you have thousands of hairs per square inch on your head
The metal that is created is virtually indestructible
Can create a one-manned machine of any sort. Color depends on hair color
weaknesses: If the hair gets wet, the titanium alloy rusts and becomes weak
If, for any reason, your hair breaks off or the metal is breaking, you lose your regular hair

name: Weapon Form
description: The power to turn people into weapons. They will only be changed into a weapon for 15 minutes. Pretty cool, huh?
summary: The ability to turn people into weapons for 15 minutes
strengths: Super strong to counter bad guys in battle
Destroy disasters
weaknesses: Lasts 15 minutes
Weapon type will fit character's personality

name: Myth Power: Techne's Teachings
description: Techne (Tekhne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of art, technology and craft. As such, channeling her allows one to access knowledge of any technical skill, at will (as well as withstand skill-based effects). In addition, one can enter a trance state, to relay psychic insights, artistically. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command machines (engine-run machines, electronic devices, etc). One can also psychically mimic electronic devices' thought processes, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Techne's command over the essence of art, technology, technical skill and craftsmenship
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of any technical skill (and withstand negative skill-based effects)
Enter a trance state, to receive psychic insights, and relay them via artistic expression
Psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic thought processes of machines
weaknesses: Cannot psychically gain/bestow/enhance/disrupt/negate magic powers until developed (NCN)
Cannot travel into technology (Cybernetic Projection) or art (Artistic Travel) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hephaestus' Forge provides negation (NCN)

name: Cd Consciousness.
description: Don't have many defensive powers? Have a major weakness? Afraid of death? Just want some extra protection? If you answered "yes" to any of these questions, this is the power for you. If the CD is put in an electronic device, you can enter and control that device. You can even burn yourself to make more CD's. Each CD also has a copy of your DNA from your touch. Uses the same process as Power Backup.
summary: The ability to put a copy of your consciousness on CD
strengths: Avoid death, unless all your CD's are destroyed.
This power automatically protects the CD from scratches.
Control electronics with the capacity to use CD's.
weaknesses: If you can't get blank CD's.
If alive, you can only access electronics through a deep trance or sleep.
CD's can be destroyed.

name: Gecko Characteristics
description: The ability to cling onto walls via sensitive pads on the palms of hands and feet, an extendable tongue used as a whip and disarming tool, the ability to camouflage into their surroundings and enhanced sight.
summary: The ability to perform feats replicating those of a gecko
strengths: The ability to cling onto walls with efficient movability
Enhanced sight which can focus on seperate objects in detail and to camouflage with ease
A useful tongue which can disarm unsuspecting enemys and cause damage lika a whip
weaknesses: The wielder will somtimes find themselves perofrming natural instincts of a gecko
The wielder will need to fulfill most of their diet by gecko food
The tendancy to get distracted by food and shinign objects

name: Myth Power: Mache's Might
description: Mache (Makhe) and the Machae (Machai, Makhai), in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of battle and combat. As such, channeling them allows one to gain superhuman fighting prowess (enhancing one's skill with all martial arts in one's physical/mental capacity). In addition, one can predict a foe's moves in combat (or to predict the moves of ANYONE in radius with hostile intent). One may turn everyday items into weapons of similar shape and size, accompanied by skill in using any weapon known.
summary: The ability to channel Mache and the Machae's command over the essence of battle, war and combat
strengths: Predict the moves of any foe, in combat or in everyday life (Combat Precognition)
Gain superhuman fighting prowess and weapons knowledge
Turn everyday items into weapons
weaknesses: Cannot reactively adapt to wield alien/divine/supernatural weapons until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Eirene's Elegance can negate this ability at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power from this ability (NCN)

name: Power Level Progress Blocker
description: Having a superpower isn't enough, you have to learn how to use it, train it, develop techniques, etc. This power allows its user to block anyone in their vicinity from making any further progress with their superpower. In other words, their level of proficiency with their power can't rise and their power can't evolve in any way. This power affects all the powers of a user, and blocks any means to level up a power.
summary: The ability to prevent the level of a power from rising.
strengths: It's frustrating for them to realize the efforts they just made to train a power were a waste.
Great against Ultimate Upgrader and, to a degree, Technique-based Power Creator.
weaknesses: You need to stay in their vicinity to keep blocking their power level.
The time and effort they'll lose is ridiculous in comparison with the time needed to master a power.

name: Death Touch
description: This power is based on flesh to flesh contact. It begins to kill cells in the target rapidly. Depending on how long contact is held, the victim can be brought to a fatal state or be killed. It may be affected by the abilities of the opponent on how it may effect them and also may not work. Ex. Hand to sleeve of opponent has no effect. It will also not have any effect on something mechanical like a robot or machine.
summary: The ability to bring upon near or full death upon a living entity through flesh contact.
strengths: May lead to quick victory.
Can cripple an opponent temporarily or permanently.
Intimidating presence.
weaknesses: Close range.
Interferes with social activities greatly.
Easy to misuse.

name: Anti Virtual  Reality
description: All powers based on virtual reality have no effect on the area 100 metres around you whenever this power is activated. This power considers any fake world on an internet server to be virtual reality as well as any power that inputs digital information into the real world.
summary: The ability to make virtual reality-based powers ineffective 100 metres around oneself
strengths: Completely counters Digitalization, Matriculation, etc.
weaknesses: Only helps against virtual reality-based powers.

name: Glowing Items
description: With this power you can easily find things by just thinking of the item, then it will instantly start glowing. It also helps if you're trying to find the enemy's secret weapon, by just thinking "The Enemy's secret weapon," it will instantly start to glow wherever it is
summary: The ability to make things glow
strengths: You can easily find things
It's fun to watch things light up when you think about them
weaknesses: You can't turn it off which means whenever you think of something it will automatically glow
It can't help you at all in physical combat

name: Shootingism
description: Basically, if you are in a room and some one has a gun you are able to control it even if it's not in your hand. You can also pick up any weapon and instantly know how to use it. Even if you have never seen it before.
summary: The ability to shoot from any rifle or weapon
strengths: Able to shoot people with 'no hands'
Shoot from any weapon
Instant knowledge of that rifle will stay with you.
weaknesses: Harmful to your brain
You can end up shooting yourself or friends
If not developed it can be deadly

name: Zigzagging Projectile
description: Whenever you throw something while having this power activated, the projectile will adopt a totally random and ever-changing zigzagging trajectory, effectively convering more space than a normal trajectory, while still moving at the same speed and in the direction it was thrown. Since it's unpredictable, it's very difficult to dodge -- it's very difficult to aim precisely too!
summary: The ability to cause things you throw to have a random zigzagging trajectory.
strengths: Covers more space than a normal trajectory and therefore has a higher chance of hitting the target.
Very difficult to predict and to dodge.
You're a nightmare if you have a machine-gun
weaknesses: The smaller the target, the more difficult it is to aim precisely and hit with this power.

name: Ology Power: Alienologist
description: Ever wanted to be like Alpha "Allen" Gray from Alienology? Now you can! You will know almost everything about loads of alien species, from stance with the Intergalactic council, weaponry, technology level, political system & biology but you will not understand the languages.
summary: The ability to know many facts about alien species
strengths: Know lots of facts about aliens, before you've even met them
weaknesses: Cannot control aliens
If aliens do not have universal translator, you cannot communicate

name: Disaster Zone
description: Wherever they go, people with this ability cause mayhem. Cars wreck, weapons misfire, things blow up, and people trip. This power is completely passive and requires no concentration. It also is unfortunately always active and can not be turned off. It does not affect you but it does affect everyone else within a 300 ft (91.44 meters) radius. Any "good luck" powers will provide protection from this ability. With practice you can learn to focus on one person, but you will still cause bad luck.
summary: The ability to passively cause bad luck to everyone else
strengths: Doesn't affect you
Gives you "virtual" good luck by making everyone else's worse
Can work on many people
weaknesses: Can't be turned off
Can cause bad luck to friends
Not many people will want to be near you

name: Legendary Weapon: Gungnir
description: This allows the user to summon and wield the legendary weapon Gungnir. This weapon belongs to the King of the Norse Gods, Odin. It's incredibly powerful and can pierce through just about anything. Also, its special ability is that it's a spear that never misses its target. It can't be stopped once in midair. Truly a fearsome weapon.
summary: The ability to summon and wield the legendary weapon of the Norse God Odin
strengths: Very powerful weapon that can pierce through just about anything
Never misses its target
Can't be stopped in midair, except by the user
weaknesses: Hard to control such a powerful weapon (takes a lot of energy to wield and control)
Getting the weapon is very difficult and chances are Odin won't just give it up

name: Virus Fixer
description: Don't you hate it when your computer gets hit with a virus and crashes? With this power that is a thing of the past! You can fix any problem that was caused by a computer virus by writing a program yourself to destroy a specific virus. The virus itself is destroyed and the problems are completely cured.
summary: The ability to fix problems caused by virtual viruses
strengths: Problems with computer viruses are gone.
weaknesses: If you're slow at typing, your computer will probably crash before you're done with the program.
Only helps with computer viruses.
Hackers

name: Thumb Drive
description: Sometimes, USB flash drives are referred to as "thumb drives." Well, with this ability, that's just what you'd have. Your fingers and thumb can temporarily change in shape to fit any removable storage port, including USB and firewire! You can copy data to and from each finger, storing a maximum of 200 TB (200,000 GB) per finger (that's about 50,000 movies). So, you'll never lose your precious docs, but be careful in the kitchen--cutting off even the tip of your finger makes that drive unusable.
summary: The ability to plug your fingers into any device and store data on them
strengths: You can store a crapload of data on your fingers (music, docs, movies, etc)
Nerds will find your data storing powers sexy
Your "special" movie collection is always readily available
weaknesses: Cutting of part of your finger kills that finger's storage capabilities
No protection from viruses
You need to keep your finger in the port to use it

name: Lexcorp
description: This power allows you to get products from Lexcorp. Lexcorp excels at many things including Robotics, food, banks,etc.
summary: The ability to get products from Lexcorp.
strengths: You get Lexcorp products.
weaknesses: It loses to other Branches.

name: Usefulness Removal
description: This ability can make anything useless and pointless by removing all uses that a target has. By removing their usefulness, the victim will be just phase through thing. Since they are now useless, it is basically nothing but a waste of space. They do not even have a physical use. The user can only use this ability on one thing at a time.
summary: The ability to remove the actual usefulness any weapons, powers, technology, etc
strengths: Remove any or all uses from anything
Superpowers are affected as well
weaknesses: The effects are only temporary.
The user can only use this ability on one thing at a time.

name: Zoading
description: This ability allows you to speed up computer loadings just by thinking, including downloads. This ability will work on any computer. Using the skill too much causes headache.
summary: The ability to speed up computer loadings.
strengths: You don't have to wait for that loading to finish
Speed up your download time
weaknesses: Causes headache if overused

name: Demon Weapon Forging
description: The weapons are created by first combining the fang, claw, or scale with metal, then turning the resulting combination into a weapon by way of the arts of the blacksmith. The weapon has powers based on those of the demon from which the fang, claw, or scale came from. Fangs tend to give offensive powers, claws tend to give agility-based powers,and scales tend to give defensive powers. However, all of the fangs, claws and scales have to come from the same demon for any individual weapon.
summary: The ability to create mystic weapons from the fangs, claws, and/or scales of demons
strengths: Can create extremely powerful weapons.
Different demons give different powers to the weapons so it is good to experiment.
Demons might pay you to make them weapons if they feel they need or want one.
weaknesses: The number of powers is random but always at least one and no more than 5.

name: Decepticon Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Decepticon or Predacon from any continuity in order to help you commit crimes. strengths: Have many useful weapons.
Add weapons.
weaknesses: Have to be able to turn into a car.
You can only put in extra weapons if their blueprints are correct and can somehow be put in.

name: Transformers: Sparkeater
description: With this power you can summon a Sparkeater from the comic series More Than Meets the Eye by James Roberts. The Sparkeater feeds off of machines and could be directed to eat humans and other living beings as well. The Sparkeater is under your control though it is also extremely unstable and needs to be kept under constant supervision. If it is shot with any kind of energy weapon it will explode in a massive explosion. You can unsummon the Sparkeater whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon a Sparkeater
strengths: You can summon a Sparkeater
It is under your control
weaknesses: It has to be kept under constant supervision

strengths: good crowd control
everyone will fear the master of lard
no limit to the power of the mighty lard
weaknesses: Sticky
smells bad
takes a lot of space when it grows

name: Omnimpotence
description: This power makes you extremely weaker than a regular human since you never build up resistance to almost anything. Some omnimpotents need life support machines since many cannot live as easily as a normal human. You are so weak that power sensors barely detect you. Power negators/augmentors/mimics/etc. Cannot affect your weak power in anyway possible.
summary: The ability to be inhumanly weak and have very few abilities.
strengths: Power manipulators have no power against you.
You are almost imperceptible to a power sense.
Weakling's Immunity works wonders for you.
weaknesses: You are weaker than a normal human.
You may need a life-support machine.
You have no real abilities or skills with only this power.

Only helps you meet characters, does not help you learn subjects vivios or loved beings really dead

name: Dk 64 Fruit Weapons
description: In the official video game called Donkey Kong 64, the protagonists use fruits as weapons. Fruits turned into weapons could explode like explosives.

strengths: The fruit you eat serves to defend
You can shoot fruit with real weapons
weaknesses: Spend large amounts of fruits to shoot them and attack them
Fruits become really dangerous as weapons

name: Dental Molding
description:
User is capable of creating various tools, weapons and variously shaped objects out of their teeth.
Size of made object depends on user's skill in this ability.
User needs to learn how to quickly remove their teeth for use of this ability. Use of this ability doesn't hurt much, it's only uncomfortable.
After user no longer concetrates on created object, it will disintigrate and tooth will regrow after some time (around half an hour).
summary: The ability to make things out of teeth.
strengths: By mastering this ability, user has arsenal of various weapons to use in fight.
Ability also grants user exactly 36 teeth.
weaknesses: Regrowing lasts long, preventing from using this ability more than 36 times in fight.
User must learn how to use ability, how to quickly remove tooth and mold it.
Tooth won't regrow, unless object made from previous one dissolves, preventing user from having arsenal of prepared teeth for fight.
